title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Cloud Developer** with strong hands-on expertise in **AWS Cloud, Node.js, Microservices, and REST API development**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting scalable, secure, and high-performance cloud-native applications, leveraging AWS services and modern software engineering practices.

Your role  
Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Design, develop, and support cloud-native applications, microservices, and REST APIs using Node.js.
* Build scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions leveraging AWS services including Lambda, EC2, S3, IAM, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, CloudWatch, AWS IoT Core, and IoT Device Management.
* Develop and implement serverless and event-driven architectures to deliver resilient and efficient cloud solutions.
* Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, and deployment processes.
* Ensure cloud security through effective implementation of IAM, access controls, monitoring, logging, and security best practices.
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and application performance tuning.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions using Agile development methodologies.
* Drive engineering excellence through Test-Driven Development (TDD), clean coding practices, code quality standards, and maintainable software design.

Your profile  
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* 5-12 years of Software Development experience with 5+ years of hands-on AWS expertise.
* Strong proficiency in Node.js, Microservices Architecture, and REST API Development.
* Experience designing and developing cloud-native, distributed, and serverless applications.
* Hands-on knowledge of AWS services including Lambda, EC2, S3, IAM, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, CloudWatch, AWS IoT Core, and IoT Device Management.
* Expertise in CI/CD pipeline development, automation, and deployment processes.
* Strong understanding of Event-Driven Architecture, Cloud Security, Scalability, Reliability, and High Availability.
* Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), Unit Testing, and Integration Testing.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS, Containerization, and Amazon ECR.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or Terraform.
* Exposure to AWS Bedrock, Generative AI, and LLM-based applications.
* Familiarity with AWS IoT solutions, Device Management, Device Shadows, and IoT integrations.
* Strong skills in performance optimization, troubleshooting, debugging, and production support.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to independently own features/modules and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring capabilities.
* Passion for engineering best practices, clean code, maintainable architecture, and continuous improvement.

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.  
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.  
Are you in?  
  
We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Public Relations Officer
description:
An **IP & OP Manager** (**Inpatient & Outpatient Manager**) in a hospital or clinic oversees daily patient flow, front-office and ward operations, billing coordination, and service quality across both inpatient (IPD) and outpatient (OPD) units.

Outpatient (OPD) Responsibilities

* **Appointment & Queue Management:** Streamline walk-in and scheduled consultations to minimize wait times and bottlenecks.
* **Doctor & Room Scheduling:** Coordinate consultation schedules, room allocation, and clinic readiness with physicians and nursing staff.
* **OPD Billing & Diagnostics Flow:** Ensure smooth registration, consultation billing, pharmacy handoffs, and diagnostic referrals.

Inpatient (IPD) Responsibilities

* **Admissions, Transfers & Discharges:** Oversee bed allocation, admission formalities, ward/ICU transfers, and timely discharge clearances.
* **Ward & Nursing Coordination:** Align nursing stations, housekeeping, dietary, and clinical support teams to maintain ward readiness and care standards.
* **IP Billing & Insurance Desk:** Coordinate itemized billing, advance tracking, and TPA/insurance approvals to prevent discharge delays.

Shared & Cross-Functional Duties

* **Patient Experience & Escalations:** Resolve patient or attendant complaints in real time and track satisfaction metrics (such as turnaround times and feedback scores).
* **Staff Supervision & Compliance:** Manage front-desk, patient-care, and floor executives—handling shifts, training, attendance, and hospital/regulatory compliance.
* **Reporting & Process Improvement:** Track OPD footfall, bed occupancy, average length of stay, and revenue leakage, reporting daily or monthly KPIs to leadership.

title: Phlebotomist
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled, empathetic, and detail-oriented **Phlebotomist** to join our diagnostic centre in Ittamadu, Banashankari. You will be responsible for collecting blood and non-blood specimens safely from walk-in patients (and home collection visits, if applicable), ensuring strict adherence to hygiene and NABL quality guidelines while delivering a calm, reassuring patient experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Patient Verification & Care:** Greet walk-in patients, verify test requisitions and identity details, check fasting/pre-test requirements, and explain collection procedures clearly to ease patient anxiety.
* **Sample Collection:** Perform venipuncture (vacutainer/syringe) and capillary punctures (finger/heel pricks) across all age groups (pediatric to geriatric) following the correct order of draw. Guide patients on collecting urine, stool, and sputum samples.
* **Labeling & Accessioning:** Barcode and label vials accurately at the point of collection, enter patient data into the Lab Information System (LIS), and maintain daily collection logs.
* **Sample Integrity & Dispatch:** Centrifuge, store, and transport specimens under proper cold-chain conditions to the processing team without hemolysis or delay.
* **Hygiene & Biomedical Waste:** Follow universal precautions, sterilize collection stations, monitor phlebotomy stock, and segregate biomedical waste as per Karnataka State Pollution Control Board / NABL norms.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Education:** DMLT, BMLT, B.Sc. MLT, or 10+2 (Science) with a certified Phlebotomy Technician course (Healthcare Sector Skill Council / NSQF preferred).
* **Experience:** 0–3 years of experience in a diagnostic centre, pathology lab, or hospital (confident freshers with strong practical skills are welcome).
* **Languages:** Fluency in **Kannada** and **English** (working knowledge of Hindi/Tamil/Telugu is an added advantage for local patient communication).
* **Additional (If Home Collection applies):** Valid two-wheeler driving licence and smartphone proficiency.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹26,000.00 per month

title: LMS Administrator and Training Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
Overview:

Bruker is enabling scientists and engineers to make breakthrough post-genomic discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high performance scientific instruments and high value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity, and customer success in post-genomic life science molecular and cell biology research, in applied and biopharma applications, in microscopy, as well as in industrial and cleantech research, and semiconductor metrology in support of AI. Bruker offers differentiated, high-value life science and diagnostics systems and solutions in preclinical imaging, proteomics and multiomics, spatial and single-cell biology, structural and condensate biology, as well as in clinical microbiology and molecular diagnostics.

For more information, please visit www.bruker.com

We are currently offering a **LMS Administrator and Training Specialist (m/f/d)** position.

Responsibilities:

**Learning Management System Administration**

* Enter and maintain course information, user enrollments, and completion records, and verify that data is accurate and complete.
* Assist in publishing courses and programs, set up hands-on training sessions, and assign job positions and competencies.
* Create and maintain competencies and update user competency records.
* Create user roles, and assign job assignments and roles to users.
* Create and manage audiences, and configure audience enrollment, learning plans, and HR imports to automate enrollment.
* Run HR imports for bulk uploads of users and job assignments.
* Write and maintain guidelines and user documentation for the system.

**User Management and Compliance**

* Onboard and offboard users.
* Migrate user records as needed.
* Prepare monthly account reports for export control review and suspend any accounts flagged during screening.
* Create and generate reports on course participation and compliance, and maintain audit documentation.

**Training Coordination**

* Plan the yearly in-person training schedule.
* Coordinate training globally, including selecting and confirming trainers, holding pre-session meetings with trainers, and tracking preparation tasks.
* Manage training bookings through email.
* Monitor enrollment levels and communicate with regional managers to fill under-booked sessions.
* Prepare and distribute training schedules, notifications, and completion certificates.

**Visa Invitation Letters**

* Maintain the invitation letter templates.
* Issue letters when requested.

**User Support and Communication**

* Manage the LMS shared email inboxes and respond to or route user requests in a timely manner.
* Answer ad hoc calls from users and stakeholders.
* Provide end-user support.
* Troubleshoot access issues and course-related issues.
* Provide second-level support and guidance to other tenants on the platform.
* Provide administrative support to trainers and system administrators.

**Technical and Server Support**

* Support Linux servers that host the LMS, including system monitoring and file management.
* Work with the external LMS vendor to report, track, and resolve technical issues.

Qualifications:

* Experience administering a learning management system, including competencies, audiences, user roles, and HR imports.
* Basic experience with Linux servers, including navigating the command line, managing files, and monitoring systems.
* Willingness to develop advanced Linux administration skills, including patching, user and permission management, log analysis, and backups.
* Experience coordinating training programs or events across multiple locations.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (min. C1 Level)

Bruker is committed to fostering an inclusive, and respectful workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and qualifications. We do not discriminate based on any personal characteristic or background protected by applicable laws.

Certain positions at Bruker require compliance with export control laws and as a result, all interviewed candidates for all positions will be screened pre-interview to determine their eligibility in light of export control restrictions.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

Senior Platform Engineer on the Software Engineering Tools and Processes (SETP) team. You will keep the platforms behind Zebra's engineering tool-chain, and the legacy engineering tools, secure, current and reliable. You will also act as the escalation point for platform issues the wider team cannot resolve. The role includes CVE mitigation, patching and upgrades, platform security hardening, administration of enterprise engineering tools, and support for CloudBees CI and Gerrit. You will work alongside the Engineering Tools Portal developers and administrators, and share knowledge across the team.

Zebra's Software Engineering Tools and Processes (SETP) team provides the tools our engineers use to build, test and ship software. We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the platform layer of that tool-chain. You will keep the underlying platforms and the legacy engineering tools healthy, secure and up to date, and you will be the escalation point for platform problems the wider team cannot resolve. You will work closely with the Engineering Tools Portal developers and administrators, along with IT teams, to support the platform our SDLC runs on.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Track CVEs affecting the engineering tools we run, decide what needs action, and drive fixes or mitigations to completion.
* Keep every engineering application on the latest supported version, and plan and drive patching and upgrades.
* Harden the pipelines, clusters and secrets handling that the Tools Portal and the wider tool-chain run on.
* Own remediation of application vulnerabilities and supply-chain tooling. Code-level fixes such as Code Smells and Security Hotspots stay with the Tools Portal developers.
* Support CloudBees CI and Gerrit infrastructure for EMC, and review and support related contractor work.
* Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Collaborator, SPIN, PVCS and ClearCase, and keep them running while they are still in use.
* Administer engineering platforms including Jira, Confluence, Artifactory, Polarion and SonarQube.
* Take part in security and program alignment discussions, and work through the infrastructure-hardening backlog.
Document legacy tool operations and share that knowledge across the team to reduce single-person dependency.  

  

**What you bring**

  

* Significant experience in platform, DevOps or infrastructure engineering.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms and pipeline hardening.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters.
* Experience with secrets management.
* Vulnerability management experience: CVE triage, risk assessment, patching and upgrade planning.
* Experience remediating application and platform security issues.
* Experience administering multiple enterprise engineering tools, such as Jira, Confluence, Artifactory and SonarQube.
* Ability to work independently and act as a technical escalation point.
* Hands-on experience with legacy software configuration management and code review tools (Collaborator, SPIN, PVCS, ClearCase).
* Experience with CloudBees CI and Gerrit.
* Experience with Polarion.
* Experience with software supply-chain security tooling.
* Experience supporting regulated or large-enterprise engineering environments.

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

**About Gracenote :**

Gracenote is the top provider of entertainment information, creating industry-leading databases of TV, movie, and music metadata for entertainment guides, applications and in-car entertainment. Our technology serves billions of requests daily to hundreds of millions of devices around the world. Our customers include innovators like Apple, Twitter, Google, Spotify, M-GO and Hulu, top consumer electronics and cable companies, and leading automotive manufacturers such as Ford and Toyota, throughout the US and the world. Simply put, data provides you with an opportunity to impact the evolution of the entire entertainment industry.

**Purpose:**

As a devops engineer, your role is to support the development teams by assisting in automation of deployment processes, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting issues. You will gain hands-on experience in implementing devops tools and practices, contributing to efficiency and reliability of our software delivery.

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Deploy, automate, maintain, and troubleshoot DevOps managed shared services
* Assist in Design, Implement and maintain scalable, reliable infrastructure to support SDLC
* Develop and manage robust CI/CD pipelines to streamline software releases and updates
* Ensure the availability, performance, scalability and security of production systems
* Contribute to automating system configurations, deployments and monitoring to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Research and implement new DevOps technologies
* Work closely with the Global DevOps and dedicated DevOps teams
* Suggest and implement best practices and architecture improvements

**Must haves:**

* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems issues and implement effective solutions.
* Demonstrable DevOps experience
* Experience with programming or scripting language such as Python, Bash, Java
* Experience working in a Linux and in a cloud environment
* Proficient in implementing Infrastructure as a code using tools like terraform and cloud formation
* Experience with Infrastructure as code, containerization such as K8s/Docker, logging, monitoring and alerting, and CI/CD tools
* Willingness to learn above mentioned qualifications if some are missing
* Minimum 3+ years provisioning, operating, and managing AWS environments
* Proficient with AWS services
* Familiarity interacting with AWS APIs
* AWS Disaster Recovery design and deployment across regions a plus

* Experience with multi-tier architectures: load balancers, caching, web servers, application servers, databases, and networking
* Experience in automation and testing via scripting & programming (PowerShell, Jenkins, Python, Ruby, Java)
* Experience with working with geographically dispersed teams
* Experience with secrets management tools like Hashicorp Vault
* Professional certifications such as AWS certified Devops Engineer, Kubernetes administrator etc
* Demonstrated experience leading devops teams or projects, fostering collaboration.

title: Tender & Bid Management Executive
description:
Tender & Bid Management Executive

**Experience:** 2-5 Years  
**Department:** Tendering / Business Development / Commercial  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive **Tender & Bid Management Executive** with 2-5 years of relevant experience in managing end-to-end tendering and bidding processes for **Government, PSU, Corporate, and Private Sector projects**.

The candidate should have hands-on knowledge of **GeM, Government e-procurement portals, private tender portals, RFQs, RFPs, EOIs, vendor registrations, quotations, commercial proposals, and bid documentation**. The role requires strong coordination, documentation, commercial understanding, and the ability to manage multiple bids within strict deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and monitor relevant **Government and Private Sector tender/bidding opportunities** through GeM, e-procurement portals, client/vendor portals, tender websites, emails, and other sources.
* Review and analyze **Tender Documents, RFQs, RFPs, EOIs, BOQs and bid specifications** in detail.
* Understand the project scope, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, commercial terms, compliance requirements, submission process, and deadlines.
* Manage the complete tendering process from **opportunity identification to final bid submission and post-submission follow-up**.
* Prepare and compile **technical bids, commercial bids, financial proposals, quotations, capability documents and supporting documentation**.
* Handle **private-sector RFQs/RFPs** received directly from corporate clients, consultants, contractors, architects, developers, and other organizations.
* Coordinate with private-sector clients/procurement teams to understand requirements, submission formats, commercial expectations, and timelines.
* Prepare **pricing sheets, BOQs, cost comparisons, commercial quotations and proposal documents** in coordination with the concerned internal teams.
* Coordinate with **Finance, Technical, Projects, Operations, Sales/Business Development, Procurement, and Legal teams** to collect required information and approvals.
* Manage **vendor registration and empanelment** processes with corporate/private clients and maintain updated vendor documentation.
* Ensure all statutory, financial, technical, and company documents required for tender participation are updated and readily available.
* Prepare **compliance statements, technical specifications, company credentials, past project details, client references, declarations, undertakings, and supporting documents**.
* Handle documentation related to **EMD, tender fees, security deposits, performance guarantees, bank guarantees and other bid requirements**, wherever applicable.
* Upload and submit tenders through **GeM and other Government/private e-procurement portals** accurately and within stipulated timelines.
* Coordinate for **pre-bid meetings, site visits, tender clarifications and corrigendum/addendum requirements**.
* Respond to clarification requests and queries raised by Government authorities, procurement teams, consultants, or private clients.
* Follow up with clients after bid submission regarding **technical evaluation, commercial negotiations, bid status, purchase orders/work orders, and final outcomes**.
* Support the management/business development team during **commercial negotiations and price revisions**.
* Maintain a detailed **Tender Tracker** covering opportunity details, client, project value, submission date, bid status, quoted value, result, and follow-up actions.
* Maintain proper records of submitted tenders, quotations, proposals, purchase orders, work orders, agreements, and related correspondence.
* Track **bid success rates, lost opportunities, competitor information, pricing trends, and reasons for bid wins/losses** where information is available.
* Ensure **100% timely and compliant submission** of all assigned bids and proposals.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

* 2-5 years of experience in **Tendering, Bid Management, Proposal Management, Commercial Coordination, or Business Development support**.
* Hands-on experience with **GeM and Government e-procurement portals**.
* Experience handling **private-sector RFQs, RFPs, quotations, vendor registrations, and commercial proposals**.
* Good understanding of **BOQs, pricing, tender terms, technical/commercial documentation, and contractual requirements**.
* Strong proficiency in **MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF documentation, and online tender portals**.
* Excellent documentation, coordination, follow-up, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work on **multiple tenders simultaneously under strict deadlines**.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail with the ability to identify missing documents, compliance gaps, and commercial risks before submission.

**Preferred Industry Exposure:** Interior Design, Construction, Infrastructure, Fit-outs, Architecture, Engineering, or related project-based industries.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

**Job Description**

Own the end-to-end solution architecture for ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM), focused on the physical hardware asset lifecycle from request and procurement handoff through receiving, deployment, transfer, maintenance, retirement and disposal. Define scalable HAM processes, asset and CMDB data flows, secure enterprise integrations and upgrade-safe platform standards. Provide architectural direction and governance for development teams and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HAM Solution Architecture & Lifecycle Design**

* **Lifecycle Architecture:** Define target-state workflows and architecture for hardware request, receipt, assignment, transfer, refresh, return, retirement and disposal.

* **Solution Blueprints:** Produce architecture designs, data flows, non-functional requirements, design decisions and phased HAM implementation roadmaps.

**Integrations, CMDB & Platform Architecture**

title: LMS Administrator
description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow's Talent Experience & Enablement team is building the infrastructure for smarter, more personalized employee experiences. We partner across the Talent organization — Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Learning, People Analytics, People Product and People Tech — to identify where technology can create real, lasting impact in how we hire, develop, and support our people.

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As the LMS Administrator, you will own the configuration and day-to-day administration of Zillow University (Docebo LMS) and serve as the platform expert for our Lines of Business, Compliance, and Tech L&D partners. You will manage two domains: an internal domain for approximately 7,000–8,000 Zillow employees and an external domain for 50,000+ partners.

You will be the hands-on Docebo expert on the team: configuring courses, learning plans, and enrollment logic; planning and running our enterprise-wide annual programs; resolving escalated (Tier 3) support issues; managing integrations and automations; and building the capability of the power users and LMS admins embedded across the business. You will also review upcoming Docebo releases and configure the features that best fit the experience we want for learners.

This role is part of the Talent Experience & Enablement team, specializing in Talent Management and Learning. Pilot design, evaluation, and launch of new learner experiences are owned by the Sr. Learning Technology Specialist, and instructional design is owned by our Talent Experience Designers; this role partners closely with both.
  
  
**You will get to**

### **Own Docebo configuration**

* Own the configuration of Zillow University in Docebo, including courses, learning plans, enrollment rules and logic, and instructor-led training (ILT) sessions.
* Configure, publish, and troubleshoot content in SCORM, xAPI, and Tin Can formats so it runs reliably and tracks accurately.
* Build and maintain user structures, branches, and enrollment groups with leaders and key partners.
* Review upcoming Docebo releases, assess impact, and configure the features that fit our desired learner and admin experience, partnering with People Tech and IT where integrations need to be updated.

### **Plan and configure enterprise and business programs**

* Plan and configure Zall Annual Training and Annual Review, including audience logic, timelines, reminders, completion tracking, and reporting.
* Support Lines of Business, ZHL Compliance, and Tech L&D with program setup, enrollment, and tracking needs.
* Track and ensure compliance completion, and partner with stakeholders to audit data and remedy gaps or inaccuracies.

### **Enable power users and embedded admins**

* Onboard and train power users embedded in Lines of Business teams.
* Train new LMS admins embedded in the business, and develop standard guides, job aids, and governance practices so they can work independently and consistently.

### **Manage integrations and automations**

* Manage integrations and automations across Zoom, APIs, Docebo Connect and partner systems like Gong, Salesforce, Slack.
* Partner with IT and People Tech to ensure user data feeds work correctly so records stay current and new learners get timely access.
* Act as liaison between IT and the LMS vendor on technical issues and updates.

### **Provide Tier 3 support and operational excellence**

* Handle Tier 3 support tickets from learners and admins, including root-cause analysis and vendor escalation.
* Monitor recurring issues, system and process gaps, and proactively identify efficiencies and enhancements.
* Generate standard and custom reports, track platform usage trends, and develop operational procedures and documentation that support LMS governance.
* Use program management tools and techniques to plan work, keep multiple projects on track, and deliver results.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Deep, hands-on Docebo expertise and a track record of configuring complex enrollment logic and learning plans
* Experience with integrations and automation (APIs, Docebo Connect or similar tools) and a working interest in emerging learning technologies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to synthesize disparate information quickly
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a coaching mindset for training power users and new admins
* Strong relationship-building and consulting skills with business partners
* Comfort with data and reporting tools (e.g., Google Sheets, API
* Demonstrated commitment to high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement
* Interest in growing toward program management, with the ability to plan and track multiple concurrent workstreams

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of LMS administration experience at a corporate organization
* Experience with Docebo (strongly preferred) and other learning management systems
* Solid understanding of xAPI (Tin Can), SCORM, and AICC standards
* Experience supporting compliance training and tracking in an LMS (preferred)
* Experience with ILT configuration, and with Zoom or Gong integrations (preferred)

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Hospital Receptionist
description:
Receptionist / Front Desk Executive

Location: Miracle Hospital

Experience Required: 1–3 years (Mandatory – Healthcare Industry)

About Us

Miracle Hospital is committed to providing compassionate, high-quality care for women, children, and families. We are looking for energetic, responsible, and patient-friendly individuals to join our front-desk team.

The Receptionist / Front Desk Executive will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors. title: Hostess
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are seeking a poised, hospitable, and energetic **Hostess** to be the welcoming face of our dining and hospitality spaces. In this role, you will greet incoming guests, manage table reservations and seating flow, assist with event and dining inquiries, and ensure every visitor enjoys a seamless and memorable experience.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Warm Guest Welcome:** Greet resort guests, club members, and day-outing visitors warmly upon arrival at the restaurant, lounge, or event venue.
* **Manage Reservations & Walk-Ins:** Handle table bookings via phone, digital reservation logs, and walk-in inquiries, coordinating closely with the Front Office and banquet teams.
* **Coordinate Seating & Flow:** Escort guests to indoor, outdoor, or Glass House dining areas, present menus, and balance table assignments evenly across server sections.
* **Assist with Resort & Dining Inquiries:** Answer guest questions regarding menu items, buffet timings, special packages, and resort amenities.
* **Special Occasions & VIP Care:** Record and coordinate special requests—such as anniversaries, birthdays, candlelight dinners, and corporate group seating—with the F&B and kitchen teams.
* **Maintain Front-of-House Standards:** Keep the host podium, entrance, and waiting areas spotless, well-stocked with menus, and aligned with resort presentation standards.
* **Guest Relations & Farewell:** Check in on waiting guests during busy weekend and event rushes, address minor concerns politely, and thank guests warmly upon departure.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** 10+2, Diploma, or Degree in Hospitality / Hotel Management preferred (freshers with strong communication skills are welcome to apply).
* **Experience:** 0–2 years of experience as a Hostess, Guest Relations Executive, or Front Office Associate in a hotel, resort, or upscale restaurant.
* **Communication:** Fluent in English and Hindi; proficiency in Kannada is a strong plus.
* **Attributes:** Polished grooming, warm demeanor, strong organizational skills, and ability to stay calm during high-volume weekend or banquet rushes.
* **Availability:** Flexible to work rotational shifts, weekends, and public holidays

description:
St. Francis College is looking for a proactive, result-oriented and well-connected Placement Officer to lead and coordinate the activities of the Training and Placement Cell. The candidate will be responsible for building strong relationships with corporate organisations, facilitating campus recruitment drives, identifying employment opportunities and preparing students for successful careers.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, networking, coordination and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to engage effectively with students, faculty members and industry professionals.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with companies, corporate organisations, HR professionals and recruitment agencies.
* Identify and generate placement opportunities for students across various UG and PG programmes.
* Organise and coordinate campus recruitment drives, pool campus interviews, walk-in interviews and placement activities.
* Coordinate with recruiters for job openings, internship opportunities and recruitment requirements.
* Conduct pre-placement activities such as resume building, aptitude training, mock interviews, group discussions and soft skills sessions.
* Guide students in career planning, interview preparation and professional development.
* Maintain an updated database of students, recruiters, placement records and employment opportunities.
* Coordinate with Heads of Departments and faculty members to ensure effective student participation in placement activities.
* Organise career guidance programmes, industry interactions, corporate talks, workshops and employability enhancement programmes.
* Track placement statistics, prepare periodic reports and maintain placement-related documentation.
* Explore internship opportunities, live projects and industry collaborations for students.
* Achieve placement targets and continuously improve the effectiveness of the Training and Placement Cell.

Educational Qualification

* Postgraduate degree in Management, Human Resource Management, Commerce or any relevant discipline.
* Additional certifications in HR, Recruitment, Career Counselling or Training will be an added advantage.

Experience

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong corporate networking and relationship-building abilities.
* Good negotiation, coordination and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes and current industry hiring trends.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace and online recruitment platforms.
* Ability to conduct placement training, mock interviews and career guidance sessions.

title: Patient Relationship Manager
description:
**About Allo Health**

At Allo Health, our vision is to make Sexual Health and Mental Health accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We are India's leading sexual health platform, offering evidence-based care through a network of digital and physical clinics. With millions of individuals facing sexual health concerns and limited access to trusted care, we are committed to providing a safe, discreet, and patient-centric healthcare experience.

**Website:** https://www.allohealth.com/

**Job Summary**

As a Patient Relationship Manager (PRM), you will be the face of the clinic and the primary point of contact for patients throughout their treatment journey. Along with managing patient interactions, coordinating consultations and handling clinic operations, you will also provide hands-on clinical support, including blood sample collection (phlebotomy), basic vitals and assisting doctors during consultations.

This role is ideal for Nursing, Phlebotomy and Medical Lab Technology professionals who want to combine their clinical skills with patient care and healthcare operations. The ideal candidate is empathetic, organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced clinic environment.

**Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Support & Sample Collection**

* Collect blood samples (venipuncture) and other diagnostic samples at the clinic as per standard protocols.
* Ensure correct patient identification, labeling, documentation and storage of samples.
* Coordinate sample pickup and handover with diagnostic lab partners, and track reports until delivered to the patient.
* Record basic vitals (BP, pulse, temperature, weight, SpO2) before consultations.
* Assist doctors during consultations when required.
* Follow infection control, hand hygiene and biomedical waste management (BMW) guidelines.
* Maintain sample collection consumables and equipment, and flag shortages in time.

**Patient Appointment & Consultation Management**

* Confirm patient appointments and consultations in advance.
* Manage appointment scheduling, rescheduling, and follow-ups.
* Assist walk-in patients with registration and consultation bookings.
* Coordinate patient flow to ensure minimal waiting time.
* Support online consultation patients when required.
* Ensure accurate patient information is maintained in the system.

**Patient Counseling & Treatment Coordination**

* Explain doctor prescriptions, treatment plans, and next steps clearly to patients.
* Guide patients through recommended treatments, tests, and procedures.
* Address patient concerns and queries with empathy and professionalism.
* Coordinate follow-ups and treatment adherence activities.

**Billing & Payment Management**

* Collect consultation, treatment, and diagnostic payments through approved payment channels.
* Handle refunds and payment-related queries as per company guidelines.

**Diagnostic Tests & Medicine Fulfillment**

* Coordinate diagnostic investigations and track pending tests and reports.
* Manage medicine fulfillment and delivery coordination.
* Track pending medicine deliveries and close them on time.
* Coordinate with internal fulfillment and logistics teams to ensure timely completion.

**Clinic Operations & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate patient records, sample logs and clinic documentation.
* Complete End-of-Day (EOD) reports and operational checklists.
* Manage clinic inventory, medicine audits and medical consumables.
* Identify discrepancies and support resolution through Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Ensure compliance with operational processes and clinic standards.
* Maintain clinic hygiene, safety, and security protocols.

**Patient Experience & Reputation Management**

* Deliver a seamless and high-quality patient experience.
* Collect patient feedback and encourage satisfied patients to leave reviews.
* Handle escalations professionally and ensure timely resolution.
* Build trust and maintain strict patient confidentiality throughout the patient journey.
* Collaborate with doctors and cross-functional teams to improve patient outcomes.

**Performance & Process Adherence**

* Maintain clinic operational and patient satisfaction standards.
* Maintain high standards of documentation accuracy and clinical compliance.
* Participate actively in training sessions and process improvements.
* Adapt to evolving operational requirements and business needs.

**Required Skills & QualificationsEducational Qualification (any one of the following)**

* B.Sc Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc Nursing
* GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)
* ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery)
* DMLT / BMLT / B.Sc MLT (Medical Lab Technology)
* Certified Phlebotomy Technician / Diploma in Phlebotomy (e.g., HSSC/NSDC certified)
* Any other related qualification

**Skills**

* Working knowledge of venipuncture and sample collection.
* Understanding of infection control, hygiene and biomedical waste handling.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Fluency in English and the local language.
* Patient-centric and empathetic approach.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving mindset.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Workspace, and basic computer applications.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Freshers (final-year and recently graduated students) are strongly encouraged to apply.
* 0-3 years of experience in hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, sample collection centres or patient coordination is an advantage.

**Training**

Selected candidates will go through a structured training program before and after joining, covering:

* Allo Health clinic processes, systems and patient journey.
* Sample collection SOPs, safety and quality standards.
* Patient counseling and communication in a sensitive, stigma-free care setting.
* Billing, documentation and clinic operations.

**Work Schedule**

* 4 hour or 8-hour shift based on clinic operational hours.
* Rotational week-offs, excluding weekends and public holidays as required by business needs.

**Growth Opportunities**

At Allo Health, we believe in developing talent from within. High-performing Patient Relationship Managers can progress into roles such as:

* Senior Patient Relationship Manager
* Assistant Manager
* City Operations Team
* Expansion team

We offer structured learning opportunities, continuous feedback, and career growth pathways to help employees build successful long-term careers with Allo Health.

**Why Join Allo Health?**

* Opportunity to work with India's leading sexual health platform.
* Use your clinical skills beyond the lab, in a patient-facing role with real ownership.
* Meaningful impact on patient lives and healthcare accessibility.
* Structured training and a fast-paced learning environment with strong growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive work culture.
* Exposure to clinical care, healthcare operations, patient experience, and clinic management.

**Interested? Students can apply here:**

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold one of the listed qualifications (Nursing, DMLT/BMLT, Phlebotomy), and can you do venipuncture independently?
* Are you comfortable working in a sexual health setting, and can you handle sensitive patient conversations with empathy and confidentiality?

title: Hostess
description:
**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

The Hostess welcomes guests and supports an organised, pleasant arrival experience at the restaurant or F&B venue. The role manages guest enquiries, reservations, seating, and waiting areas while coordinating with service teams to support smooth floor operations.

The position requires a warm and professional manner, clear communication, strong organisation, and the ability to manage guest flow during busy periods.

**Guest Welcome and Reception**

Welcome guests promptly and courteously as they arrive.

Create a positive first impression by maintaining a professional and approachable manner.

Ask guests about their requirements and guide them through the arrival process.

Assist families, groups, and guests with specific seating or accessibility needs.

Maintain a visible and attentive presence at the entrance or reception area.

**Reservations and Seating**

Manage reservations and walk-in requests in line with venue procedures.

Confirm reservation details and communicate relevant information to the floor team.

Coordinate table allocation based on availability, guest requirements, and service flow.

Update reservation records and waiting lists accurately.

Inform guests of estimated waiting times only when confirmed by the relevant team.

**Guest Flow and Waiting Area Management**

Monitor the entrance, waiting area, and guest queue to support orderly movement.

Communicate wait times, table status, or other updates clearly and politely.

Coordinate with the F&B Floor Supervisor regarding table readiness and guest flow.

Identify congestion or guest concerns and seek support when required.

Keep the reception and waiting areas clean, organised, and presentable.

**Guest Information and Enquiries**

Provide accurate information about the menu, venue, operating hours, and available facilities.

Direct guests to the appropriate team for detailed menu, billing, or service enquiries.

Stay updated on promotions, events, menu changes, and operational updates.

Avoid giving unconfirmed information or making commitments outside the scope of the role.

Communicate special requests to the relevant service team.

**Guest Service and Issue Escalation**

Respond to routine guest requests in a helpful and professional manner.

Listen to guest feedback and refer complaints or unresolved concerns to the supervisor.

Coordinate with service staff to support special occasions or other reasonable requests.

Follow up with the concerned team on guest needs where appropriate.

Maintain discretion and courtesy in all guest interactions.

**Team Coordination and Administration**

Coordinate with service staff and supervisors on table availability and guest requirements.

Maintain reservation logs, guest lists, and other records as required.

Communicate delays, special requests, and guest updates to the floor team.

Support the team during events, busy periods, and shift transitions.

Carry out other front-of-house duties assigned by the reporting manager.

**Service Standards and Presentation**

Follow venue procedures, guest service standards, and company policies.

Maintain professional grooming, punctuality, and workplace discipline.

Keep reception materials and guest-facing areas neat and ready for use.

Protect guest information and handle reservations appropriately.

Support a welcoming and orderly environment throughout the shift.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

High school certificate or equivalent is required; a diploma in Hospitality or Hotel Management is preferred.

2–5 years of experience in restaurant hosting, reception, guest relations, or F&B service.

Experience with reservations or restaurant seating systems is an advantage.

Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong organisation and the ability to manage several guest requests at once.

Professional presentation and a customer-focused approach.

Ability to remain calm and courteous during busy service periods.

Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹21,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Specialist - Supplier Quality
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as **ROLE**.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager- Supplier Quality** to lead supplier quality activities for new product launches and supplier development initiatives across Plastic Injection Molding and Stamping/Metal commodities. The role will be responsible for ensuring flawless project execution using APQP methodologies and driving zero-defect launches through strong supplier quality management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead development and qualification of supplier-manufactured child parts using **APQP and PPAP methodologies**.
* Manage supplier quality activities from project initiation through **SOP + 180 days**.
* Drive successful launch readiness and achieve **Zero Defect Launch** objectives.
* Conduct regular supplier reviews and Gemba walks throughout the product development lifecycle.

### **Supplier Quality Management**

* Develop and support both existing and new suppliers in project management and quality systems.
* Conduct supplier audits in accordance with organizational and industry standards.
* Investigate quality concerns, drive root cause analysis, and implement robust corrective actions using **8D methodology**.
* Monitor supplier performance and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

### **Project & Stakeholder Management**

* Strengthen project management systems at supplier locations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure on-time and high-quality project execution.
* Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, and suppliers.

**Required Skills & Expertise**
-------------------------------

### **Technical Competencies**

* Strong expertise in:

  + Plastic Injection Molding Processes
  + Stamping / Metal Manufacturing Processes
  + Plastic and Stamping Tooling
  + Project Management
  + Supplier Quality Management
* Advanced knowledge of automotive quality tools:

  + APQP
  + PPAP
  + PFMEA
  + SPC
  + MSA
  + 8D Problem Solving

### **Behavioral Competencies**

* Add Value

* Data-driven decision making
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Detail-oriented with a deep-dive approach

* Excellent stakeholder management capabilities

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **B.E. /** **B.Tech** in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Diploma in Tooling will be an added advantage.

**Certifications**
------------------

* IATF Internal Auditor Certification (preferred)
* Six Sigma Certification (preferred)

**Experience**
--------------

* **10-12 years of experience** in Supplier Quality, with significant expertise in:

  + Plastic Injection Molding
  + Stamping / Metal Components
  + Project Supplier Quality
  + Supplier Development and APQP Implementation

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Salesforce Consultant with expertise in Commerce Cloud B2B and Order Management System (OMS) to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and hands-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.

title: SAP Material Management (MM) / S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

The core purpose of an SAP Materials Management (MM) / S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement Consultant is to design, implement, and optimize an organization's supply chain, procurement, and inventory operations using SAP software. They act as the bridge between a business’s logistics needs and technical execution within SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA.

  

Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high-level design documents to implement identified components. Ensure implemented components are documented appropriately, unit tested, and ready for integration into the final product. Present/demonstrate implemented product features through playback sessions as required. Provide fixes to defects identified during pre-production and post-production phases in the software development life cycle. Provide work estimates for assigned development work. Guide and explain features, functional objectives, or technologies that are being built to interested parties.

  

Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization—experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build, and optimize enterprise supply chain foundations while modernizing legacy procurement workflows to seamlessly integrate with modern cloud and S/4HANA architectures.

  

**What you will do**

* **Lead Solution Architecture & Workshops:** Drive end-to-end solution architecture, lead business requirement-gathering, conduct fit-gap analysis, and facilitate blueprinting sessions for purchasing, inventory, and pricing workflows.
* **Configure S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement:** Configure and customize SAP S/4HANA MM and SD settings, including enterprise structure, purchasing organizations, release strategies, account assignment, and MRP (Material Requirements Planning).
* **Develop RICEF Specifications:** Analyze client business requirements to write detailed functional specifications for Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEF).
* **Drive Cross-Module & Cloud Integration:** Connect SAP S/4HANA with adjacent modules (FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, EWM) and cloud suites like SAP Ariba (Cloud Integration Gateway / CIG, guided buying, and catalog management).
* **Manage Data Migration & Cutover:** Oversee master and transactional data migration (Material Master, Business Partner/Vendor Master) using tools such as LSMW, BDC, or MDG, and coordinate go-live cutover activities.
* **Execute Testing & Deployment:** Build test scripts, conduct system integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), resolve pre- and post-production defects, and provide post-go-live hypercare support.
* **Deliver Documentation & Enablement:** Draft comprehensive process flow documentation and configuration guides, train key business end-users, and stay current on SAP best practices.

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. title: Senior Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in Verification, verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
* Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem/SoCs in the Networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control desired.
* Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
* Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) Accelerators or vector processing units.
* Experience with the full verification life cycle.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
  
  
In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. You will collaborate closely with design and verification engineers in active projects and perform verification.  

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

  
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Plan the verification of digital design blocks and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
* Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
* Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
* Measure to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
* Create a constrained-random verification environment using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).

title: Mainframe System Security Specialist
description:

You will protect critical systems, networks, and data by managing access controls, enforcing security policies, monitoring security activities, and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

  

**What You Will Do**

* Support internal and external audits by providing security evidence and remediation plans.
* Implement security policies, standards, and procedures for IBM Z environments.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.

Our partnerships with industry alliances and vendors mean you'll have access to skilling and certification programs needed to excel in Security & Resiliency, while simultaneously supporting your personal growth. Whether you envision your career path as a technical leader within cybersecurity or transition into other technical, consulting, or go-to-market roles – we’re invested in your journey. .

You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Mainframe Security Administration.
* Strong experience with IBM RACF (Resource Access Control Facility).

* Knowledge of RACF commands, utilities, and security reporting tools.

Understanding of security exits and RACF customization.  

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Good understanding of z/OS architecture and security concepts.
* Knowledge of TSO/ISPF, JES2/JES3, SDSF, JCL, and mainframe operations.
Understanding of Dataset security, USS security, and started task security.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. title: Staff UX Researcher, Mixed Methods
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in an applied research setting, or similar.
* 8 years of experience planning, conducting, and synthesizing user research for consumer-facing digital products in industry.
* Experience in leading end-to-end UX research strategy across both qualitative (ethnography, deep interviews, usability testing) and quantitative (surveys, behavioral analytics, telemetry collaboration) methodologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or a related field.
* 10 years of user research experience, with 3 years of experience in a staff-level lead role within a global technology company.
* Experience leading field studies for Next Billion Users (NBU) and emerging markets, collaborating across global design and research teams in the US, Europe, and India.
* Expertise in conversational AI interfaces, location-based services, maps, navigation, and growth.
* Strong executive communication skills, with experience translating complex user behaviors into clear narratives that drive strategic impact and influence cross-functional product leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a User Experience Researcher (UXR), you make this possible. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to gather insights and create industry-leading products.
  
  
You’ll play a critical role in helping your team understand user needs and will drive impact at all stages of product development, ensuring products are useful, usable, and helpful. You will explore user behaviors and motivations by conducting primary research, including: field studies, interviews, diary studies, ethnography, surveys, usability testing, and logs analysis. You will also grow within a supportive UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools.

Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world-scale impact.

The overall of Geo's "Strategic Markets & NIU" team is to drastically grow usage of Google Maps and other geospatial products across strategic emerging markets and amongst Novice Internet Users (NIU).

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the Google Maps research outlook and roadmap by partnering with UX, Product, Engineering, and executive leaders to align user needs with business goals and translate insights into actionable product strategy, specs, and design frameworks.
* Pair quantitative and qualitative research methods to achieve the research goal and product advancement. Quant research to include stand-alone and in-product surveys, metrics development, etc.
* Explore and embrace AI tools to take our user research processes to the next level, to create efficiencies, innovate processes, and expand the impact of the UX Researcher role.
* Drive AI conversational evaluations and hyper-local field research across India and surrounding regions to optimize low-connectivity transit experiences and fuel sustainable Android user growth for Google Maps.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Production Team Leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Manufacturing Operations Leader will oversee day-to-day shop floor operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable production while meeting quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives. This role will lead manufacturing teams in a unionized environment, manage production execution and workforce performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires strong operational problem-solving capabilities, effective industrial relations management, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver customer commitments and build a high-performance manufacturing culture.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets.
* Manage production execution, workforce allocation, and capacity planning to meet manufacturing schedules and customer commitments.
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities in addressing moderately complex to complex manufacturing challenges related to safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Lead and develop shop floor teams in a unionized manufacturing environment while maintaining positive industrial relations and employee engagement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, collective bargaining agreements, company policies, and workplace discipline requirements.
* Monitor and improve key manufacturing performance indicators, including throughput, yield, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), cycle time, productivity, and on-time delivery.
* Conduct daily production reviews, Gemba walks, and structured problem-solving activities to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, reduce waste, and optimize manufacturing costs.
* Ensure adherence to Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS), quality, regulatory, and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Human Resources teams to resolve operational challenges and achieve business objectives.
* Proactively address production disruptions, quality concerns, workforce constraints, and equipment-related issues to maintain manufacturing continuity.
* Develop team capabilities through coaching, training, multi-skilling, performance management, and employee development initiatives.
* Support manufacturing automation, digitization, factory modernization, and productivity improvement projects.
* Encourage employee participation in safety, quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence activities.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and performance-driven shop floor culture focused on teamwork, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **4+ years** of experience in manufacturing operations, production management, or industrial engineering roles.
* Experience managing shop floor operations in a unionized/industrial relations environment.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, and capacity management.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving operational excellence initiatives.
* Working knowledge of labour laws, collective bargaining processes, and employee relations practices.

**Desired Characteristics**
---------------------------

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and structured problem-solving methodologies in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead, coach, and motivate diverse manufacturing teams while maintaining positive employee relations.
* Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to interpret manufacturing KPIs and translate findings into improvement actions.
* Experience supporting manufacturing automation, digitization, or factory modernization initiatives.
* Ability to prioritize competing operational demands and make timely decisions in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* Strong planning, documentation, and execution skills, with a collaborative and results-oriented approach.

**Inclusion and Diversity**
---------------------------

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Shift Manager
description:
A Cold Stone Creamery **Shift Manager** is responsible for leading shift operations, supervising crew members, managing cash and POS accuracy, maintaining product quality, and ensuring food safety and store security whenever the Store Manager is off-duty.

**Shift Leadership & Floor Supervision**

* **Station Deployment:** Assign Team Members to specific roles (granite stone, POS register, waffle/production, restocking) and adjust positions dynamically during peak rush hours.
* **Coaching & Onboarding:** Train new crew members on portion control, mixing techniques, and hospitality standards, while providing real-time feedback on the floor.
* **Pacing & Checklists:** Manage crew break schedules without slowing down service and verify that opening, mid-shift, and closing checklists are completed on time.

**Customer Experience & Quality Control**

* **Service Recovery:** Resolve guest complaints, order errors, or delivery partner delays promptly and professionally.
* **Product Audits:** Check finished Creations™, shakes, smoothies, and ice cream cakes for accurate portion weights, presentation, and ingredient freshness.
* **Delivery & Online Order Flow:** Monitor online/aggregator orders alongside walk-in queues to prevent kitchen and counter bottlenecks.

**Cash Handling & Shift Reconciliation**

* **Till & Safe Accountability:** Count and verify opening and closing cash drawers, authorize POS voids, refunds, or discounts, and handle safe drops or bank deposits.
* **Shift Reporting:** Log daily wastage, complimentary items, and shift sales totals accurately during shift handovers.

**Production, Inventory & Food Safety**

* **Daily Prep Targets:** Ensure sufficient ice cream tubs are tempered, waffle cones/bowls are baked ahead of peak hours, and cake displays remain stocked.
* **Stock & Receiving:** Conduct daily/weekly inventory counts, verify incoming vendor deliveries against invoices, and enforce strict FIFO (First-In, First-Out) rotation.
* **Hygiene & Store Security:** Monitor refrigeration/freezer temperature logs, enforce food safety and personal hygiene rules, and execute store opening or lock-up security protocols.

Benefits:
