title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
A Cold Stone Creamery Team Member (often called a Crew Member) manages front-of-house hospitality, frozen granite stone preparation, kitchen production, and store sanitation in a fast-paced dessert environment.  
**Customer Service & Hospitality**

* **Greeting & Engagement:** Welcome guests immediately (standard expectation is within 3 seconds of entry) with high energy and a friendly attitude. In many locations, crew members also participate in brand traditions like singing when tips are dropped.
* **Menu Guidance:** Answer questions about flavors, dietary preferences, and ingredients, and recommend Signature Creations™ or custom mix-in combinations.
* **Order Accuracy:** Listen carefully to custom orders, confirm sizes and mix-ins, and ensure smooth handoff for both walk-in guests and online/delivery orders.

**Food Preparation & Granite Stone Operations**

* **Crafting Creations:** Scoop accurate portions of ice cream and fold in candies, fruits, nuts, and syrups on the chilled granite stone according to portion control standards.
* **Baking & Production:** Prepare fresh waffle bowls and cones, bake brownies or cookies, and assist in making ice cream cakes, cupcakes, cookie sandwiches, and smoothies/shakes.
* **Restocking:** Keep the mix-in rail, dipping cabinet, and toppings stocked and visually neat during peak hours.

**POS & Cash Handling**

* **Billing & Checkout:** Operate the Point-of-Sale (POS) register accurately, ensuring items and extra mix-ins are neither under-rung nor over-rung.
* **Payments & Reconciliation:** Handle cash, UPI/card payments, gift cards, and promotional coupons accurately, and assist with drawer counts at shift changes.

**Cleanliness, Food Safety & Inventory**

* **Sanitation:** Wipe down the granite stone, countertops, sneeze guards, and customer seating areas continuously. Wash dishes, sanitize utensils, mop floors, and empty trash bins during and after closing shifts.
* **Food Safety Compliance:** Follow strict personal hygiene, uniform standards, and temperature logs, using daily opening/closing checklists.
* **Stock & Cold Storage:** Receive deliveries, rotate stock using FIFO (First-In, First-Out), and organize supplies inside walk-in refrigerators and blast/storage freezers.

Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.

* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.

title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a **hands-on AI/ML Engineer** to join our **Information Systems (IS)**.

This is a **specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with **Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

**Work model:** Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from **SAP and Salesforce** to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from **Snowflake** and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including **Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions**.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, **cost monitoring, root-cause analysis**, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry**: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake AI/ML tools** (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating **SAP and Salesforce** data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
* Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

The Product Analyst is responsible for supporting product operations and delivering a consistent user experience across sales tools and platforms. This role serves as a key connection between sales users, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Engineering teams by translating product updates into operational readiness and effective user support. Responsibilities include troubleshooting user issues, analyzing support trends, assessing the impact of product defects, maintaining support knowledge, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and the overall user experience.

The Product Analyst is expected to stay current on product releases, enhancements, known issues, and communications from Product Owners and relate these updates to incoming user support tickets. The role requires strong ownership, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to continuously expand knowledge across the broader Sales ecosystem.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to effectively use emerging technologies and Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot to support everyday work and drive measurable process improvements.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Provide frontline product and operational support across CRM and the broader Sales tools ecosystem by troubleshooting user requests in line with established priorities, processes, and SLAs, while collaborating with regional stakeholders, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Stay current on product releases, enhancements, known issues, and updates communicated by Product Owners, and proactively connect these changes to user support tickets, recurring issues, and potential user impact.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills when working with users, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders, ensuring clear, timely, and professional communication throughout issue resolution.
* Triage user-reported issues and quickly assess severity, scope, and business/user impact. Where a potential product defect is identified, promptly raise and coordinate incidents with Engineering teams with appropriate analysis, evidence, and supporting details.
* Use Jira effectively to create and maintain user stories, defects, and bugs with clear problem statements, business/user impact, supporting evidence, acceptance criteria, and appropriate prioritization.
* Take ownership of creating, reviewing, and continuously updating knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and user-support documentation based on recurring issues and established resolutions.
* Analyze incoming support tickets and recurring issue patterns to identify opportunities for proactive support, automation, ticket reduction, and enhancement of the overall user experience.
* Support user onboarding, access provisioning, data-management activities, and other operational processes in accordance with defined business processes, controls, and governance requirements.
* Conduct user training and knowledge-sharing sessions covering product functionality, business processes, new features, and relevant product updates.
* Continuously expand expertise beyond individual CRM applications and develop the ability to support the broader Sales tools and technology ecosystem. Demonstrate learning agility and the ability to quickly adapt to new products, processes, tools, and technical skill sets as business needs evolve.
* Identify enhancements, automation opportunities, and process improvements based on support insights and user feedback, and partner with appropriate Product and Engineering teams to recommend solutions.
* Actively leverage Generative AI tools, including Claude and other approved AI capabilities, as part of day-to-day work and demonstrate tangible AI-enabled process improvements each quarter, with a focus on reducing manual effort, improving turnaround time, enhancing support quality, or increasing operational efficiency.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement by proactively identifying gaps, proposing solutions, documenting learnings, and sharing knowledge across the team.
* Identify enhancements, automation opportunities, and process improvements based on support insights and user feedback, and partner with appropriate Product and Engineering teams to recommend solutions.
* Actively leverage Generative AI tools, including Claude and other approved AI capabilities, as part of day-to-day work and demonstrate tangible AI-enabled process improvements each quarter, with a focus on reducing manual effort, improving turnaround time, enhancing support quality, or increasing operational efficiency.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement by proactively identifying gaps, proposing solutions, documenting learnings, and sharing knowledge across the team.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years’ experience in Product Operations, CRM, Sales Technology, Application Support, Product Support, or a related role supporting business-critical applications.
* 2+ years hands-on experience with enterprise CRM and/or Sales platforms, with the ability to troubleshoot application and user issues and understand their business impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical or product-related information to users, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to independently triage issues, assess user/business impact, distinguish potential defects from support issues, and coordinate appropriate escalation.
* Experience collaborating within global, cross-functional stakeholders involving Product, Engineering, Operations, and business stakeholders.
* Strong learning agility and willingness to continuously expand knowledge across Sales tools, technologies, business processes, and emerging capabilities.
* Digital fluency and hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to improve productivity, automate repetitive activities, or drive measurable operational improvements.  
  Preferred Qualifications

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience supporting enterprise CRM and Sales platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Salesforce, or similar applications, with an understanding of sales processes and user-support operations.
* Experience using Generative AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Microsoft Copilot, to automate repetitive activities, improve support quality, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable quarterly process improvements.
* Familiarity with integration platforms, ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira), and collaboration tools used in global operations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:
Key Responsibilities:

proficiency in other areas.

1. Leadership and Strategy:

 Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth

based on business needs.

 Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from

conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.

 Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these

in design activities.

 Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC

and container solutions that align with business objectives.

customer.

project plan.

 Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof-of-concept

engagements to a successful conclusion

 Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.

 Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments

related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.

 Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show & Tell for HPC and container

platform solutions and integrations.

 Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving

complex cloud technology issues

 Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer

experiences to drive customer success.

 Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non-technical

stakeholders

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including system administrators,

developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project

delivery.

 Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources

within the company

 Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech

talks, forums, innovation.

Required Skills:

 Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management,

scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and

networking concepts.

 In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with HPC technologies, workload

schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster

manager.

 In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with containerization technologies like

Docker, Singularity, or Podman.

 In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two of the container

orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE

Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or HPE Ezmeral Runtime. Good

to have

 Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.

 Good knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM,

OpenShift virtualization

 Good knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two various Linux

distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.

 Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU

technology

 Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand,

Mellanox

 Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC

components

such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and

container orchestration platforms.

 Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash

 Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.

 Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS

 Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.

 Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to

interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the

architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and

drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.

 Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.

 Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.

 Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

Qualifications:

 Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a

related field.

 Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist,

or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.

 Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF

certification - CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.

 Typically, 6-13 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform

projects.

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Engineer - Digital Forensics
description:
**About this role:**

At Wells Fargo, a Principal Engineer defines long-term engineering solutions for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups or the enterprise. You will translate strategic technology opportunities into technical direction, guide resolution of unique challenges, and provide leadership with insight on significant solutions and emerging technologies.

**In this role, you will:**

* Advise leadership on applications, networks, information security, databases, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
* Translate advanced technology experience, business objectives, enterprise technology environments, organizational structures, and strategic opportunities into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction, and expertise to leadership on innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry practices and emerging technologies and recommend innovations that enhance operations or competitive position
* Strategically engage with professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as a technical advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of focused professional experience in DFIR, threat hunting, and digital forensics within highly regulated industries (financial services preferred) or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi‑team, enterprise‑wide programs in highly regulated organizations.
* Strong knowledge of digital forensics and incident response principles, tooling, and frameworks (e.g., case management systems, SOAR, log pipelines, forensics investigations, event triage).
* Familiarity with SOC and IR functions, threat intelligence, detection engineering, and crisis management.
* Experience with SIEM tools like Splunk , Crowdstrike etc.
* Proficiency with program and project management tools and frameworks (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, SAFe, Agile, Waterfall/Hybrid).
* Demonstrated proficiency in Python, PowerShell or equivalent scripting languages with practical experience automating forensic evidence collection, processing and investigative workflows.
* Exceptional communication skills, including executive‑level reporting, stakeholder engagement, and risk management.
* Ability to operate effectively across highly technical and non‑technical domains, balancing operational needs with engineering constraints and business priorities.
* Proven ability to analyze malware and malicious artifacts, including dynamic and static analysis, memory forensics, and identification of persistence mechanisms (formal reverse‑engineering experience is a plus).
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud incident response (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including log analysis, IAM investigations, container workload forensics, and cloud-native security tooling.

**Job Expectations:**

* Perform Tier 3 investigation on critical cyber cases in 24\*7 environment.
* Conduct forensic analysis of cyber incidents including hacking, malware attacks, data breaches and insider threats.
* Identify, preserve, extract and analyze digital evidence from computers, mobile devices, servers, cloud systems, and other digital storage media.
* Use industry-standard forensic tools and techniques (e.g., FTK, EnCase, X-Ways, Autopsy, Volatility, Cellebrite) to uncover evidence and trace cyber attackers
* Lead and execute advanced digital forensic investigations involving endpoint, cloud, network, mobile, email, and SaaS platforms to determine root cause, impact, data exposure, and attacker methodology.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable forensic acquisition and analysis workflows, including custom scripts, artifact parsers, and automation to improve investigation efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as Incident Commander during major security events, coordinating cross‑functional technical teams, legal, compliance, risk, and executive leadership to drive timely containment and eradication actions.
* Conduct threat hunting activities leveraging SIEM, EDR, network telemetry, and intelligence sources to proactively identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behaviors, and emerging threats targeting the financial sector.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and standard operating procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and evolving threat landscapes.
* Build and maintain forensic readiness capabilities, including logging strategy, chain‑of‑custody processes, evidence retention standards, forensic imaging workflows, and tooling optimization.
* Collaborate with Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and internal Audit teams to support investigations involving insider threats, data misuse, fraud activity, and regulatory reporting.
* Perform malware triage and reverse‑engineering (as appropriate) to evaluate malicious payloads, persistence mechanisms, pivot paths, and risk to the institution, providing actionable intelligence to detection engineering teams.
* Drive continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities by identifying monitoring gaps, recommending new security technologies, tuning alerts, and contributing to security architecture reviews.
* Prepare high‑quality written reports and executive‑level briefs summarizing findings, incident timelines, business impact, and recommendations for remediation and long‑term risk reduction.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to junior analysts, delivering training in forensic methodologies, investigative techniques, threat analysis, tool usage, and incident response best practices.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to delivering cloud products that meet the needs of customers tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the full lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to grow efficiently in existing regions and launch entirely new regions while meeting the high-capacity needs of large and hyperscale customers.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Software Development Engineer to provide technical leadership for this greenfield platform. You will define architecture and engineering strategy for highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. You will solve ambiguous, cross-organizational problems; establish durable technical patterns; and raise the engineering bar while remaining deeply engaged in design, implementation, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.

This role combines broad autonomy with the opportunity to integrate with existing OCI systems through well-established contracts. You will influence the direction of a foundational platform at cloud scale and help shape how OCI continues to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a hands-on cloud engineer and technical leader with a record of delivering high-scale, high-impact distributed systems.
* You turn ambiguous business and infrastructure problems into clear technical strategy, phased execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
* You care deeply about customers and consistently make sound trade-offs among reliability, security, velocity, simplicity, and cost.
* You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product leaders, and partner teams.
* You set a high engineering bar, use data to build consensus, and constructively challenge assumptions.
* You thrive in a fast-moving environment, take ownership across organizational boundaries, and mentor engineers at multiple levels.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS/BTech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience designing, shipping, and operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership for complex, multi-service initiatives, including architecture definition, technical roadmaps, design reviews, and delivery across multiple teams.
* Strong proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; proficiency with scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Deep experience with distributed-systems fundamentals, microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication, data consistency, fault tolerance, and highly available service design.
* Experience designing production services with robust observability, including service-level indicators/objectives, dashboards, metrics, alarms, capacity planning, and operational runbooks.
* Proven production-operations experience, including incident response, root-cause analysis, on-call practices, and driving systemic reliability improvements.
* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and programming paradigms.
* Ability to author and communicate technical proposals, architecture documents, design specifications, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience building control-plane and/or data-plane solutions for a cloud provider or other large-scale infrastructure company.
* Experience with the physical asset lifecycle in cloud-scale data centers, including planning, delivery, inventory, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems, capacity-planning tools, or physical infrastructure workflows.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving complex performance, scaling, and reliability issues in large distributed environments.
* Track record of establishing technical standards, reusable platform capabilities, or engineering practices adopted across teams.

Responsibilities

* Own and evolve the technical architecture for services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Lead the design and delivery of resilient, scalable, secure, and operable services for the end-to-end physical asset lifecycle.
* Translate long-term business and infrastructure goals into technical strategy, architecture roadmaps, and sequenced execution plans.
* Remain hands-on: prototype critical paths, review code and designs, solve difficult technical problems, and guide implementation of high-risk components.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, operations, security, and partner organizations; establish clear interfaces and durable integration contracts.
* Define and champion operational-excellence standards, including observability, service health, incident learning, capacity planning, and reliability goals.
* Identify systemic risks, technical debt, and scaling bottlenecks; prioritize improvements using customer impact and data-driven analysis.
* Raise the technical bar through architectural reviews, engineering standards, technical mentorship, and constructive feedback.
* Influence major decisions for new and existing products, build consensus around trade-offs, and communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, simplicity, and iterative delivery while balancing speed with quality.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).
* Experience with AWS and container/Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD (GitLab or similar), and observability tooling such as Datadog.
* Rigorous about quality: unit and integration testing (Jest, Playwright or equivalent), code review, monitoring.
* A track record of independently delivering well-scoped features with quality; communicates clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and seeks guidance when facing ambiguity .
* BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: Area Manager
description:
**About Supertails**
--------------------

Supertails is a pet care company built around everything a pet parent needs in one place. We run an online pharmacy and food business, teleconsultation with qualified vets, and a growing network of veterinary clinics and grooming centres.

The clinic network is the part of the business this role sits in. Our clinics bring the care online channels cannot give: consultations, diagnostics, procedures, vaccinations and grooming, delivered by vets, paravets, groomers and front of house teams who see the same pets and their families again and again.

We are scaling that network, and the quality of a visit cannot be allowed to depend on which clinic a pet parent walks into. That is the problem this role exists to solve.

**Purpose of the role**
-----------------------

You run a cluster of Supertails clinics as one business. You carry the revenue and the cost of every clinic in it. You hold the same standard of care, hygiene and service in each one whether or not you are standing in it. And you build Centre Managers who can run their clinic well on the days you are somewhere else.

This is a hands on operating role, not an oversight role. The cluster performs the way you run it.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Cluster performance**

* Revenue, cost and contribution for every clinic in the cluster, read clinic by clinic and not as a cluster average.
* Capacity and utilisation: appointment load, vet and paravet deployment, grooming slots, walk in conversion, repeat visits.
* The cost lines you control: manpower cost against revenue, consumables, local spend.
* A growth plan for each clinic, with the actions and the timeline that sit under it.

### **Standards in every clinic**

* Hygiene, safety, premises, equipment uptime and stock availability, checked on a published audit cadence rather than on visits.
* Service standards for pet parents: wait time, handover quality, complaint closure.
* Clinical process compliance alongside the Lead Vet and the CVO office. Clinical judgement sits with the clinical line. You own that the process is followed.

### **People**

* Lead the Centre Managers: set their goals, review them weekly, coach them, and hold them to the standard.
* Train and motivate frontline staff with the function leads, with the Centre Manager as the day to day manager.
* Build bench strength so no clinic runs single deep on any critical role, and run deployment with the Centre Managers.
* Attendance, discipline, exits and recognition carried out to policy, with HR.

### **Governance**

* Keka as the single record for attendance, leave and employee data across your cluster.
* Statutory and licence compliance for the premises you run.
* Escalate what you cannot close locally, with the facts attached.

**Essential experience**
------------------------

* 4 to 8 years running multi site operations.
* Concurrent responsibility for 5 to 8 sites. Sites run one after another do not count.
* Direct P&L ownership at cluster level. Not single site P&L, and not support to someone else who held it.
* Experience leading a team spread across a city, where managers are seen weekly rather than daily, with a method you can demonstrate for holding standards in locations you do not personally supervise.
* An operating rhythm that you designed and implemented yourself: a daily call, a weekly scoreboard, an audit cadence or an equivalent of your own. You should be ready to describe it in detail.
* Proven ability to train, motivate and lead both Centre Managers and frontline staff.

Format matters more than sector. Multi site retail, clinics, salons, diagnostics, QSR, fitness and similar formats all count.

**Preferred, not essential**
----------------------------

* Experience in a veterinary, healthcare, diagnostics or other regulated service format.

title: Veeva CRM Configurator
description:
**Introduction**
================

At Slipstream Life Sciences, we help pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations transform and manage their technology ecosystems through strategic consulting, implementation, and managed services.

Our Veeva Commercial practice supports clients across CRM implementations, migrations, integrations, and ongoing platform support. As the industry transitions from Salesforce-based Veeva CRM to Veeva Vault CRM, we are expanding our offshore delivery team and investing in developing our team's Vault CRM capabilities.

We are looking for experienced Veeva CRM configurators who want to build on their existing expertise and grow into the next generation of Veeva CRM technology.

**Location:** Offshore – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Working Hours:** Standard offshore hours with flexibility for overlap with US teams  
**Practice:** Veeva Commercial

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Slipstream is seeking a **Veeva CRM Configurator** to join our offshore Veeva Commercial delivery team.

This is a hands-on technical configuration role focused on implementing, enhancing, testing, and supporting Veeva CRM solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

The ideal candidate has practical experience configuring Salesforce-based Veeva CRM, understands life sciences commercial processes, and can independently execute configuration activities based on functional and technical requirements.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.** Slipstream will provide structured training and hands-on opportunities to transition experienced Veeva CRM configurators to Vault CRM as part of our growing implementation practice.

We are looking for individuals with strong foundational configuration skills, technical aptitude, and the ability to learn new platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Configure and maintain Salesforce-based Veeva CRM, including objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, profiles, permission sets, and other administrative settings.
* Configure and support core Veeva CRM capabilities, including account management, HCP/HCO management, call reporting, product management, territory management, and sample management.
* Support Veeva commercial modules such as CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, Events Management, and other multichannel capabilities based on project requirements.
* Translate functional requirements and solution design specifications into accurate, scalable, and maintainable CRM configurations.
* Work closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and technical teams to implement approved solution designs.
* Perform configuration changes, enhancements, troubleshooting, and defect resolution across development, testing, and production environments.
* Support data loading, validation, and reconciliation using appropriate Salesforce and Veeva tools.
* Participate in CRM implementation and migration projects, including configuration assessments, build activities, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Develop and execute unit tests and support system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing.
* Maintain configuration documentation, technical specifications, deployment records, and test evidence.
* Support release management activities, including configuration migration between environments and production deployments.
* Collaborate with offshore and onshore teams to resolve technical issues and deliver assigned configuration tasks within project timelines.
* Participate in Slipstream's Vault CRM training program and progressively support Vault CRM configuration and implementation activities.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong hands-on experience configuring Salesforce-based Veeva CRM.
* Good understanding of Salesforce administration and configuration, including objects, fields, relationships, layouts, profiles, permission sets, validation rules, flows, and security.
* Practical knowledge of Veeva CRM functionality, particularly call reporting, account management, territory management, product setup, and sample management.
* Experience configuring or supporting Veeva CRM modules such as CLM, Approved Email, Engage, MyInsights, or Events Management.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into CRM configuration.
* Experience with Salesforce data management tools, including Data Loader, and familiarity with data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience troubleshooting configuration issues and resolving defects.
* Understanding of CRM deployment processes, sandbox environments, change sets, or other deployment tools.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, Excel, or similar tools for data analysis and validation.
* Familiarity with life sciences commercial business processes and regulated delivery environments.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* **3+ years of hands-on Veeva CRM configuration or administration experience** in a life sciences environment.
* Experience working on at least one Veeva CRM implementation, enhancement, or major release project.
* Demonstrated ability to independently configure CRM functionality based on documented requirements.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support activities.
* Experience collaborating with functional consultants, business analysts, architects, and development teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with distributed global delivery teams.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience supporting Veeva CRM implementations or migrations across multiple markets or business units.
* Experience with Veeva Network, Veeva Align, Vault PromoMats, or related Veeva Commercial products.
* Salesforce Administrator certification or relevant Veeva CRM training.
* Exposure to Veeva Vault or Vault CRM is beneficial but not required.
* Experience with Salesforce automation, deployment tools, and integrations.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence.
* Experience working in an offshore delivery model supporting US or global clients.

**Vault CRM Training and Career Development**
---------------------------------------------

As part of this role, selected candidates will have the opportunity to transition their existing Veeva CRM configuration skills to Veeva Vault CRM.

Slipstream will provide training and practical exposure to help team members develop capabilities in:

* Vault CRM platform architecture and configuration fundamentals.
* Vault objects, fields, relationships, layouts, and security.
* Vault CRM commercial functionality and configuration.
* Vault platform administration, workflows, lifecycles, and business rules.
* Vault CRM data management and deployment processes.
* Veeva CRM to Vault CRM migration concepts and configuration mapping.
* Hands-on Vault CRM implementation and support activities.

Candidates are **not expected to have prior Vault CRM experience or certification**. However, a willingness to learn Vault CRM and develop expertise in the platform is an important expectation of this role.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunities to work on Veeva CRM implementation, migration, and managed services programs for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.
* Structured training and hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM.
* Exposure to global life sciences clients and enterprise CRM transformation programs.
* Career development opportunities toward Senior Configurator, Technical Lead, and Solution Architect roles.
* A collaborative delivery environment with experienced Veeva professionals.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Interested candidates should submit their resume highlighting their hands-on Veeva CRM configuration experience, including the modules they have configured, implementation projects supported, and technical responsibilities performed.

**Prior Vault CRM experience is not required.**

Slipstream IT makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

title: Senior Facilities Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Position Overview
  
The Housekeeping Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing all housekeeping operations within the facility to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation. This role involves supervising housekeeping staff, coordinating cleaning schedules, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations while maintaining cost-effective operations.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Operational Management
  
Oversee daily housekeeping operations across all facility areas including offices, restrooms, common areas, conference rooms, and exterior spaces. Develop and implement efficient cleaning schedules and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain consistent quality standards. Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with cleanliness standards and identify areas requiring attention or improvement. Coordinate deep cleaning activities, specialized cleaning projects, and periodic maintenance tasks.
  
Team Leadership and Supervision
  
Supervise and manage housekeeping staff, providing clear direction, training, and performance feedback. Develop work schedules ensuring adequate coverage across all shifts and facility areas. Conduct regular team meetings to communicate expectations, address concerns, and promote continuous improvement. Monitor staff productivity and performance, implementing corrective actions when necessary.
  
Vendor and Inventory Management
  
Manage relationships with third-party housekeeping service providers, ensuring contract compliance and service quality. Monitor inventory levels of cleaning supplies, equipment, and materials, coordinating timely procurement. Evaluate and recommend cleaning products and equipment that balance effectiveness, safety, and cost-efficiency. Negotiate contracts and pricing with suppliers to optimize operational costs.
  
Quality Assurance and Compliance
  
Implement and maintain quality control systems including inspection checklists and audit procedures. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations including OSHA standards and local requirements. Maintain Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for all cleaning chemicals and ensure proper handling protocols. Address complaints and service requests promptly, implementing corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
  
Budget and Cost Management
  
Develop and manage the housekeeping department budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-saving opportunities. Prepare regular reports on operational costs, staffing levels, and service metrics. Analyze consumption patterns and implement initiatives to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
  
Emergency Response and Special Projects
  
Respond to emergency cleaning situations including spills, accidents, or unexpected events requiring immediate attention. Coordinate housekeeping support for special events, conferences, or facility activities. Participate in facility improvement projects, providing input on housekeeping requirements and standards.
  
Qualifications
  
Required
  
Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 3-5 years of housekeeping management experience in commercial facilities, corporate offices, or hospitality environments. Proven track record of managing teams and delivering high-quality housekeeping services. Strong knowledge of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and best practices. Understanding of health and safety regulations related to housekeeping operations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and facility management software.
  
Preferred
  
Professional certification in Facility Management (CFM, FMP) or related credentials. Experience with green cleaning practices and sustainability initiatives. Knowledge of LEED or other green building standards. Experience managing vendor relationships and contract negotiations. Six Sigma or Lean management training.
  
Essential Skills and Competencies
  
Strong leadership and team management abilities with the capacity to motivate and develop staff. Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to prioritize competing demands. Detail-oriented approach with commitment to maintaining high standards. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, for interacting with staff, vendors, and facility occupants. Problem-solving mindset with ability to address issues proactively. Customer service orientation with focus on occupant satisfaction. Budget management and cost control capabilities. Ability to work flexible hours including occasional evenings or weekends as needed.
  
Physical Requirements
  
Ability to walk and stand for extended periods during facility inspections. Capability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Ability to climb stairs and access all facility areas for inspection purposes. Comfortable working in various environmental conditions including temperature variations.
  
Working Conditions
  
This position operates in a professional office facility environment with regular inspections throughout all building areas. The role requires flexibility to respond to urgent situations and may occasionally require work outside standard business hours to address emergency situations or support special events.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

title: ServiceNow Technical Lead
description:
Overview:

As a **ServiceNow Technical Lead** at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.

The Opportunity:

**In this role you will:**

* Act as the technical lead for the ServiceNow platform, providing direction on solution design, configuration, development and integration.
* Take technical ownership of platform health, performance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Establish and maintain ServiceNow development, configuration and technical governance standards.
* Design, configure and develop ServiceNow solutions.
* Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow best practices, favouring standard platform capabilities and controlled configuration over unnecessary customisation.
* Assist with designing and supporting integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise applications.
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues and provide technical leadership during major or recurring incidents.
* Review technical solutions and developments delivered internally or by implementation partners to ensure quality, security and maintainability.
* Lead the technical planning and delivery of ServiceNow upgrades, patches and releases, including impact assessment, testing and remediation.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve platform performance, automation, security, user experience and technical debt.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, Enterprise Systems, architecture, integration and security teams to translate requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other colleagues working with the platform.

**We would love to hear from you if you:**

* Have a minimum of 8 years' experience working specifically in a ServiceNow Technical Lead, Lead Developer, Technical Consultant or equivalent senior technical ServiceNow role.
* Have strong hands-on experience designing, configuring and developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Have strong knowledge of JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting, including Business Rules, Client Scripts and Script Includes.
* Have practical experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs and ServiceNow integration patterns.
* Have experience designing and implementing secure ServiceNow access controls, including roles and ACLs.
* Have experience leading or providing technical ownership for ServiceNow platform upgrades and releases.
* Understand ServiceNow development and architecture best practices and the importance of maintaining an upgradeable, supportable platform with controlled customisation.
* Have experience troubleshooting complex ServiceNow technical and integration issues.
* Can translate business requirements into clear technical designs and solutions.
* Are comfortable reviewing and challenging technical solutions produced by developers, consultants and implementation partners.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Have strong organisational and prioritisation skills and can balance operational support, technical debt, project delivery and continuous improvement.
* Take a proactive approach to problem solving and technical risk management.
* Enjoy taking technical ownership and continually developing your knowledge of the ServiceNow platform.

**Desirable Experience**

It would be advantageous if you also have experience with:

* ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Knowledge Management.
* ServiceNow CMDB and Configuration Management.
* ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping or Event Management.
* ServiceNow Service Catalog and Employee Center.
* ServiceNow Performance Analytics and reporting.
* ServiceNow IntegrationHub and MID Server implementations.
* Identity and access integrations, including Microsoft Entra ID/SSO.
* Agile delivery using Jira equivalent tooling.
* ITIL or IT Service Management practices.
* Working alongside enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure and integration teams.
* Leading, mentoring or providing technical direction to developers and platform administrators.

**Certifications**

Relevant ServiceNow certifications would be advantageous, particularly:

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* Relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications aligned to the modules being managed

All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

Monitor SAP HANA database health and performance and support system refreshes, client copies, kernel updates, and parameter reviews.

As a Senior Network Administrator, you'll play a critical role in maintaining and supporting Epsilon's global network infrastructure by ensuring the availability, stability, and performance of our production network environments across multiple datacenters and cloud platforms. You'll be part of a passionate team of network professionals responsible for the operational support of complex network technologies, using your expertise in routing, switching, load balancing, network security, and cloud networking to provide world-class 24x7x365 operational support.
  
  
Your work will directly influence the reliability and operational excellence of our internal and edge Internet/peering infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with Network Engineering, Network Delivery, Security, Cloud Engineering, vendors, and business partners to ensure services are delivered consistently while maintaining operational standards and procedures.
  
  
If you're a detail oriented network professional eager to grow and make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, service-based enterprise environment, we'd love to connect with you.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
**What You'll Achieve:**
  

* Provide advanced operational support for network services, tools, and infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Perform incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for complex network issues across LAN, WAN, Cloud, Internet, and routing technologies.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for Network Operations and provide leadership during major incidents and service disruptions.
* Monitor and maintain network availability, performance, and capacity across production environments using enterprise monitoring platforms and operational dashboards.
* Perform configuration management, software upgrades, maintenance activities, and operational changes while adhering to change management processes and operational standards.
* Support hybrid and multi-cloud networking technologies using Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, AWS, GCP, and Azure platforms.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering and Delivery teams to successfully transition new services and technologies into production support.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures to improve service reliability and reduce operational risk.
* Use automation tools and scripting languages to improve operational efficiencies and reduce manual processes.
* Support network monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms to provide proactive identification and remediation of service issues.
* Perform vulnerability remediation activities and support security initiatives across network and cloud environments.
* Participate in disaster recovery testing, maintenance activities, and operational readiness exercises.
* Continuously assess operational processes and find opportunities to improve service delivery through automation, standardization, and best practices.
* Collaborate with multi-functional teams to define operational requirements and support strategic infrastructure initiatives.
* Mentor junior administrators and engineers while promoting operational excellence across the organization.
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Who You Are:**  
**What you'll bring with you:**
  

* 10+ years of experience supporting large-scale, high-performance production network environments.
* Deep expertise supporting WAN and routing topologies, datacenter switching architectures, firewall technologies, and traffic management platforms.
* Demonstrable experience supporting secure hybrid multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, and Azure networking services.

title: Senior Analyst, Learning - Continuous Listening
description:
Job Description:

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise Learning Applications, while also providing technical application and integration leadership for the Continuous Listening platform.

The role is primarily accountable for the global learning technology portfolio, including Cornerstone OnDemand adjacent learning platforms and application rationalization. It also owns the technical enablement of Continuous Listening on Qualtrics, with emphasis on integrations, data flows, identity and access, security, releases and production support.

This role combines program management, stakeholder leadership and application ownership. It translates business priorities into governed roadmaps, coordinates cross-functional delivery, manages vendors and ensures solutions are scalable, secure, supportable and aligned with Schneider Digital architecture.

**Scope and Impact**
====================

* Primary responsibility for global Learning Applications serving employees, partners, customers and other learning populations.
* Technical and integration responsibility for the global Continuous Listening platform and its connected HR data and reporting ecosystem.
* Leadership of multi-region programs, releases, pilots, upgrades, integrations, migrations, application lifecycle decisions and operational improvements.
* Senior stakeholder interface across Global HR COEs, business leaders, Schneider Digital, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement, regional teams and strategic vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Learning Applications Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver the learning technology roadmap aligned with enterprise HR and Schneider Digital strategy.
* Own the application lifecycle for Cornerstone OnDemand and connected learning platforms, including roadmap, releases, upgrades, feature enablement, service performance and lifecycle decisions.
* Program-manage the transition to Learn / Single Architecture and selected Learn+ capabilities, coordinating environment readiness, configuration, integrations, UAT, cutover, hypercare and stabilization.
* Coordinate learning integrations across HR master data, identity and access, skills, content providers, analytics and data platforms, collaboration tools and external learning audiences.
* Lead portfolio rationalization, supporting retain, integrate, consolidate, replace and retire decisions across global and regional learning applications.
* Coordinate responsible-AI, data, content, privacy, cybersecurity and production-readiness governance for AI-enabled learning capabilities.
* Drive adoption and measurable value across discoverability, learner engagement, time to competence, administration efficiency, platform reliability and workforce readiness.

**Continuous Listening Technology and Integration Ownership**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Own the technical application lifecycle and roadmap for the Qualtrics Continuous Listening platform, including environments, configuration governance, releases, vendor changes and transition to steady-state support.
* Lead integration design and delivery across HR source systems, employee and organizational data, identity and access management, SSO, APIs, middleware, secure file transfers, survey distribution processes, dashboards and approved downstream analytics.
* Define and govern interface specifications, data mapping, transformation rules, scheduling, reconciliation, monitoring, error handling and support ownership for end-to-end data flows.
* Coordinate technical readiness for survey waves and dashboards, including population and hierarchy validation, role-based access, anonymity and confidentiality controls, testing, deployment, hypercare and rollback planning.
* Ensure controls for privileged access, personal and employee-experience data, retention, encryption, audit logging, third-party security, privacy reviews, application certification and remediation evidence.
* Lead incident and problem management for platform, integration, data-quality and reporting issues, including root-cause analysis, vendor escalation and corrective-action tracking.
* Maintain solution architecture, integration inventory, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, access models, environment strategy, release calendar, runbooks and operational documentation.
* Translate listening, survey and dashboard requirements into scalable technical designs and clearly communicate feasibility, constraints, dependencies and risks to business stakeholders.
* Provide technical governance for platform enhancements and AI-enabled listening use cases before production release.

**Program and Project Leadership**
----------------------------------

* Lead end-to-end delivery from intake and discovery through planning, execution, UAT, launch, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Build integrated plans covering scope, milestones, stage gates, resources, financials, RAID, dependencies, change, adoption, vendor deliverables and operational handover.
* Run steering reviews, decision forums, executive reporting, escalation management and cross-functional delivery cadences.
* Establish clear readiness and go/no-go criteria covering business, technical, data, security, privacy, support and change readiness.
* Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban and enterprise stage-gate practices based on initiative needs.

**Stakeholder, Change and Vendor Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior technology partner to Learning, Employee Listening and HR COEs, translating priorities into executable digital roadmaps.
* Facilitate requirements, prioritization and trade-off decisions among business owners, regions, technical teams and vendors.
* Prepare executive-ready status reports, decision papers, recommendations and QBR materials.
* Drive structured change, communications, administrator enablement, user readiness and adoption measurement.
* Hold Cornerstone, Qualtrics and service partners accountable for technical deliverables, issue resolution, roadmap commitments and SLA performance.
* Support renewals, SOWs, license planning, commercial assessments, forecasts and benefits reporting.

**Operational Excellence, Risk and Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Ensure clean transition to operations with defined L1/L2/L3 ownership, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths and service reviews.
* Drive incident reduction, change success, integration reliability, data quality and mean time to restore.
* Ensure architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, data-protection, accessibility and production-readiness requirements are completed before release.
* Promote reusable technical standards, integration patterns, delivery checklists, governance templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, HR Technology, Learning Technologies or a related field.
* 8 to 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise applications, HR technology or digital transformation, including at least 3 years leading global or multi-region initiatives.
* Strong experience with enterprise learning platforms such as Cornerstone OnDemand, including application lifecycle, releases, integrations and production support.
* Technical application or integration experience with survey and employee-experience platforms such as Qualtrics.
* Hands-on experience defining or governing integrations using APIs, SSO/SAML, secure file transfer, middleware/connectors, HR data feeds, organizational hierarchies and analytics or dashboard data flows.
* Experience with UAT, cutover, hypercare, release management, operational handover, incident/problem management and vendor-led technical delivery.
* Demonstrated stakeholder-management experience across senior HR, business, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement and vendor organizations.
* Strong understanding of SaaS security, access controls, data privacy, application certification, audit evidence and service management.
* Excellent program management, executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and structured problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner.
* Agile Scrum Master or SAFe certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Cornerstone OnDemand Administrator or relevant vendor certification.
* Qualtrics platform or integration training/certification.
* Azure Integration Services, API management, Power BI, data fundamentals or AI-focused certification.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Success Metrics**
===================

* On-time and on-budget delivery of learning and Continuous Listening technology roadmap commitments.
* Successful Learn / Learn+ releases against technical readiness, UAT, cutover, security and stabilization criteria.
* Reliable Qualtrics integrations, accurate survey populations and hierarchies, stable dashboard data flows and successful production releases.
* Platform stability, SLA achievement, change success, incident reduction and improved MTTR.
