* Strong stakeholder confidence, timely decisions, transparent risks and effective vendor performance.
* Compliance performance, including privacy, privileged access, security remediation, certification and audit readiness.
* Adoption, operational efficiency, platform simplification and measurable business outcomes.

**Working Model**

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
About ECI
  
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
  
At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by our commitment to empowering our employees around the world.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
ECI has an exciting opportunity for a Network Operation Center Engineer - Monitoring, who will be responsible for providing 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services for our global customers.
  
  
In this role, you will troubleshoot network and system devices, support LAN/WAN infrastructure, and respond to Level 1 and 2 service tickets. You will collaborate closely with your team and escalate issues to higher support levels as needed.
  
  
This is an onsite role.
  
  
**What you will do:**  

* Resolve Level 1 and 2 network and system support cases, incidents, and work orders related to end-user issues, both on-premises and in cloud infrastructure, following ECI-defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring a customer-centric approach. Manage incidents via the ServiceNow tool and adhere to client escalation procedures while handling direct customer calls.
* Validate incidents and requests from a centralized management system, addressing issues such as alarm verification, routing protocol/switching issues, connectivity problems, and hardware impairments.
* Perform initial troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network or system events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control processes for network device changes, IOS upgrades, disk expansions, and reboots, ensuring client approvals are obtained.
* Provide quality, timely, and accurate end-to-end support for all issues within your functional area, including documentation and tracking in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage third parties, such as ISPs, for circuit impairments and hardware/bandwidth issues.
* Coordinate continuously with collaboration teams and respond to emails promptly, ensuring clear communication with stakeholders.
* Provide input and feedback for the development and improvement of the department and ECI.

**Who you are:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience in network and system support and monitoring.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical information to non-technical audiences and summarize key information effectively.
* Proficient problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to analyze system problems and drive corrective actions.
* Good documentation skills and the ability to absorb and retain information quickly.
* Highly self-motivated and directed, willing to work in a 24x7x365 environment.
* Experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of routers, switches, Cisco ASA, FTDs, Palo Alto firewalls, and Meraki WLCs.
* Familiarity with server/workstation support, including Active Directory, LDAP, WMI, and SNMP in Windows and Linux environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, Google, and Microsoft 365 suite.
* Knowledge of physical and virtual server technologies, including RAID/Storage, SAN, and OS.
* Experience with virtualization solutions like Hyper-V and VMware.
* Certifications such as CCENT, CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA), Microsoft Certified Solution Expert (MCSE), Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert are preferred, along with knowledge of TCP/IP and Cisco routing/switching technologies.

**Bonus points if you have:**  

* Capable of multitasking in a high-volume environment and effectively prioritizing tasks under pressure.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Experience with Managed Service Providers (MSP) & Familiarity with the ServiceNow tool.
* Experience with monitoring tools like LogicMonitor, ConnectWise Automate, RMM, or SolarWinds.

title: Sr. Integrated and ABM Specialist
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Role**

As an Integrated Campaign & ABM Specialist, you’ll help shape how Sprinklr engages priority audiences and enterprise accounts. You’ll turn audience insight, account intelligence, and business priorities into connected experiences that build engagement, support pipeline progression, and create opportunities for account growth. This is a hands-on role for a B2B marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and translate performance signals into clear action.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means delivering campaigns that feel like one connected experience rather than a collection of channel activities. Your programs help account teams understand where engagement is building, which buying-group members matter, and what action to take next. You’ll be known for reliable execution, clear communication, strong partnership, and the ability to turn performance signals into better decisions.

**What You’ll Do**

* Plan and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns from brief and audience strategy through launch, optimization, and performance reporting.
* Build campaign journeys across email, content, webinars, virtual events, paid media, social, web, executive engagement, and sales-assisted outreach.
* Execute 1:1, 1: Few, ABM programs for priority accounts, industries, segments, and buying groups.
* Develop campaign briefs, audience definitions, messaging frameworks, content requirements, channel plans, project timelines, and stakeholder updates.
* Coordinate the creation of account- and persona-relevant assets, including landing pages, emails, sales plays, executive invitations, one-pagers, and digital experiences.
* Manage campaign operations with strong attention to quality, governance, dependencies, budgets, agencies, and launch readiness.
* Monitor engagement, buying-group coverage, conversion, pipeline progression, sourced and influenced pipeline, and account outcomes; translate findings into optimization actions.

* Identify opportunities to challenge established campaign practices, test new engagement approaches, and convert successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, personalization, content workflows, and performance analysis while protecting quality, accuracy, customer trust, and brand standards.

**What Makes You Qualified**

* 5–7 years of experience in B2B integrated marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, campaign management, or a related discipline; enterprise SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of 1:1, 1: Few ABM motions, buying groups, persona-led journeys, account research, and relevant account-specific experiences.
* Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional marketing teams in a matrixed, global environment.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Analytical fluency across engagement, conversion, funnel, pipeline, and account-level performance metrics.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to turn complex inputs into actionable plans.
* Hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics, paid media, webinar, and project-management platforms.
* Familiarity with ABM and intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or Terminus is preferred; comparable account intelligence experience is welcome.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

**What You’ll Help Achieve**

In your first year, you’ll help establish a dependable, insight-led campaign and ABM operating rhythm that improves account engagement, strengthens Sales partnership, and connects marketing activity to measurable business progress.

* Consistently deliver integrated campaigns and ABM plays against agreed briefs, milestones, quality standards, and business priorities.
* Improve engagement and buying-group coverage across priority audiences and accounts.
* Create a dependable operating rhythm with Sales and partner teams, including clear targeting, activation, follow-up, and feedback loops.
* Provide actionable reporting that connects campaign activity to funnel progression, pipeline, and account outcomes.
* Build reusable playbooks, templates, and learnings that improve campaign quality and scale.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Chief Advancement Officer (CAO) provides executive leadership and strategic direction for the entire advancement function of Intentional Life Media, including Family Life Radio and Intentional Living. Through a multistate radio network, digital media, and community engagement, Intentional Life Media advances its Christ-centered mission and depends on sustainable philanthropic and partnership revenue.

The CAO leads the advancement team, establishes revenue objectives, cultivates key donor relationships, and is accountable for overall advancement performance, revenue growth, and responsible stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CAO partners with the President/CEO, Board of Directors, and other leaders to strengthen donor relationships, diversify revenue, and advance long-term ministry sustainability.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and execute annual and multiyear advancement strategies aligned with organizational priorities and financial objectives.
* Establish revenue goals, budgets, key performance indicators, and accountability standards across all advancement functions.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report directors; establish clear responsibilities and ensure coordinated execution.
* Monitor performance, revenue forecasts, donor trends, and risks; provide strategic recommendations to the President/CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
* Lead high-priority fundraising initiatives and partner with the President/CEO and Board of Directors on philanthropic priorities, significant gifts and donor relationships, and appropriate board engagement in fundraising.
* Provide strategic direction and overall accountability for on-air fundraising, pledge drives, direct-response and recurring giving, donor acquisition and retention, midlevel and major gifts, planned and legacy giving, and ministry/business partnerships.
* Oversee donor acquisition, cultivation, stewardship, retention, upgrades, and communication of ministry impact.
* Lead the development of mission-aligned business, corporate, and nonprofit relationships in coordination with the Director of Business Partnerships and relevant organizational leaders.
* Ensure donor and partner relationships reflect integrity, confidentiality, respect for donor intent, and alignment with ministry values.
* Oversee donor relationship management systems, data integrity, prospect research, donor services, gift administration, reporting, and fundraising technology through the Senior Director of Direct Response and Advancement Operations.
* Manage the Advancement Department budget, revenue forecasts, fundraising expenses, and resource allocation; evaluate net revenue and fundraising effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Programming, Finance, and other departments to coordinate fundraising campaigns, donor communications, audience engagement, and ministry initiatives, aligned with organizational strategy, brand standards, and mission priorities.

**SUCCESS MEASURES AND WORK EXPECTATIONS:**

* Success is measured by net revenue growth, donor retention and file growth, mid-level and major gift pipeline, planned gift commitments, and cost to raise a dollar. Requires on-site presence during pledge drives, with some evening/weekend hours and occasional travel.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Minimum of ten (10) years of progressively responsible advancement, fundraising, or nonprofit revenue-development experience, including at least five (5) years of leadership or management experience.
* Demonstrated success leading fundraising strategies, achieving revenue goals, cultivating major donors, and developing diversified revenue streams.
* Experience leading managers or directors, managing budgets, establishing performance measures, and using data to guide decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with executive leadership and lead cross-functional initiatives.
* Preferred: Advanced degree and/or CFRE credential; experience leading advancement for an evangelical Christian ministry, nonprofit media organization, radio network, or comparable mission-driven nonprofit; pledge drive or telethon experience.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Executive leadership, strategic planning, and ability to achieve measurable revenue results.
* Expertise in comprehensive fundraising, major gifts, donor development, and diversified revenue generation.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Financial acumen in budgeting, forecasting, fundraising analysis, and resource allocation.
* Ability to develop leaders, establish accountability, integrate multiple functions, and drive results.
* Commitment to ILM and ECFA standards, including Code of Ethics, donor confidentiality, and responsible stewardship.
* The CAO must demonstrate a personal relationship with Jesus Christ and commitment to Intentional Life Media’s evangelical Christian mission, statement of faith, and organizational values.
* The CAO is expected to uphold the organization’s Employee Handbook, Ethical Positions Statement, and applicable policies; and faithfully participate in and financially support a local church consistent with the organization’s stated beliefs.

**BEHAVIORAL STANDARDS**

* Seek to be a role model in attitude, speech, and actions in a consistent daily walk with Jesus Christ.
* Integrate Biblical principles and a Christian worldview into all organizational objectives and goals.
* Have a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Be committed to furthering Intentional Life Media’s mission as a faith-based organization.
* Agree to uphold Intentional Life Media’s statement of faith.
* Be willing to submit to and honor the standards outlined in the Employee Handbook and Ethical Positions Statement.
* Faithfully attend and financially support a local church whose beliefs agree with Intentional Life Media’s.

title: ALM Transformation Lead - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Functional Job Title** : Finance CoE-Treasury Asset Liability Management, Associate Vice President

**Reports to :** Finance COE Manager, AVP

**Department/ Division :** Finance CoE, Global Treasury, Asset Liability Management (ALM) Team

  

**Basic Purpose of Job:**

The Asset Liability Management (ALM) team within Global Treasury is responsible for optimizing the company’s balance sheet while maximizing net interest revenue (NIR) within our risk appetite and regulatory constraints. Key functions within ALM include balance sheet and NIR forecasting and interest rate risk (IRR) management which are supported by groups focused on data analytics, balance sheet modeling and senior management and Board reporting. ALM is also responsible for coordinating the company’s deposit pricing strategy, return on capital and funds transfer pricing methodologies and balance sheet strategy. ALM works closely with other functions across Global Treasury, Finance, Risk Management and Business Units.

This role sits at the intersection of Asset Liability Management, quantitative risk, technology, and business intelligence. This is a Senior Analyst contributor role within Treasury responsible for driving the end-to-end modernization of the ALM operating model — migrating manual, spreadsheet-intensive processes onto a cloud-powered, BI-driven platform anchored by QRM as the central calculation engine.

The role accelerates a transformation programme already underway. Immediate priorities include productionalising the Treasury Management Dashboard, executing the QRM Publish to MR integration to create a governed time-series dataset on cloud, and deploying Power BI on structured QRM outputs. Longer-term, the role will extend the ALM modernization model beyond ALM. The successful candidate will combine deep ALM domain expertise with hands-on QRM experience, Power BI or Tableau capability, and cloud data architecture knowledge.

  

### **Responsibilities & Tasks Include:**

**QRM Modernization & Integration**

* Lead the migration of complex Excel-based ALM calculations into QRM, including NII simulation, EVE sensitivity, gap analysis, and liquidity stress testing.

* Own the implementation of the QRM Publish to MR functionality — designing the data flow from QRM outputs back to input transactional data to create a structured, governed time-series dataset on cloud.

* Explore and deploy QRM's attribution walk modules for NII and EVE, enabling waterfall analysis from base to target positions for senior management reporting.

* Manage the end-to-end QRM environment including scenario libraries, behavioural model inputs, repricing terms, and rate assumptions — ensuring all inputs are sourced from the single unified data layer.

**Cloud & Data Architecture**

* Partner with Data and IT functions to design and execute the migration of QRM time-series outputs to cloud storage.

* Define the data architecture that stitches QRM outputs to input transactional data in the cloud, enabling full lineage, audit trail, and automated refresh.

* Establish and govern the single source of truth for ALM data — ensuring all downstream reporting, BI tools, and risk systems consume from one authoritative, reconciled dataset.

**Business Intelligence & Reporting**

* Deploy Power BI dashboards on top of structured QRM outputs and cloud-hosted time-series data, replacing manual Excel-heavy reporting workflows.

* Drive the productionalisation of the Treasury Management Dashboard (TMD), expanding coverage across ALM, Liquidity, CIO, and Capital functions.

* Build self-service reporting capability so analysts can drill into any metric by product, segment, currency, or maturity bucket without IT dependency.

**ALM Process & Analytics**

* Produce NII and EVE attribution analysis that explains rate risk movements driver-by-driver, linking risk metrics directly to commercial margin outcomes.

* Develop time-series analytics and trend reporting to support ALCO and board-level decision making, earnings preparation, and regulatory stress-test readiness.

* Tie interest rate risk reporting to commercial margin metrics on the asset and liability sides of the balance sheet, enabling integrated risk and return analysis.

**Stakeholder Management & Governance**

* Present progress and outcomes directly to the Treasurer, ALCO, and senior management, translating technical developments into business impact.

* Manage relationships with QRM vendors, cloud infrastructure teams (DART/IT), and BI platform owners.

* Track and report against audit findings, MRM items, and model risk governance requirements within the Treasury Management Dashboard

* Support headcount planning, IT budget management, and implementation milestone tracking

### **Job Requirements:**

### **Education and Experience:**

* 8–10 years of experience in Asset & Liability Management, Treasury, or interest rate risk at a bank, custodian, or financial institution

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

* CFA, FRM, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

### **Skills/ Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience with QRM (Quantitative Risk Management) including model configuration, scenario design, NII/EVE simulation, and ideally Publish to MR or attribution modules.

* Demonstrated experience leading or materially contributing to an ALM or treasury technology transformation — not just working within an established model but rebuilding or modernizing one.

* Experience designing or working with cloud-based data architectures for financial risk data — Azure, AWS, or GCP data lake environments.

* Able to take a highly technical QRM output or cloud architecture and communicate the business impact clearly to a Treasurer, CFO, or ALCO board.

* Track record of deploying BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) on large financial datasets to replace manual Excel-driven reporting.

* Comfortably owning a transformation programme end-to-end — from requirements definition through build, parallel run, sign-off, and decommissioning of legacy processes.

* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including IRRBB (BCBS 239), LCR, NSFR, and internal stress testing requirements.

* Surfaces issues early, manages stakeholder expectations transparently, and produces clear written materials for senior audiences without being asked.

* Works effectively across ALM, Liquidity, CIO, and Capital functions as well as IT, Data, Modeling, Risk, Audit, QRM vendor, and BI platform teams — this role is inherently cross-functional

title: Engineering Manager, Data Foundations
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**
------------------------

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Data Foundations team — the team responsible for data ingestion, data quality, and cost management across ServiceTitan's data platform. You'll stay hands-on and technically engaged, guiding architecture personally rather than delegating it, while building and leading a team of strong engineers across the US and India.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and Mentor: Manage and grow a team of 5+ data engineers spanning multiple regions and time zones. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and build a team culture rooted in ownership and psychological safety.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership: Stay hands-on — review architecture and code, prototype solutions to hard problems, and personally guide the team's technical direction rather than delegating all design work.
* Architecture, Data Quality & Cost: Drive architecture for data ingestion (Kafka, custom ETL Agent), Snowflake, and Airflow; own the strategy for data quality tooling and monitoring; and lead cost optimization efforts, balancing efficiency with reliability and long-term platform health.
* Operations & Stakeholder Collaboration: Own the operational posture of the platform — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call — while championing data governance best practices and partnering with product, architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver the roadmap.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience: 8+ years in data or software engineering, with 2+ years managing engineering teams of 5 or more.
* Building & Leading Global Teams: Proven experience building and leading engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones, with strong async-first habits and comfort setting technical direction without relying on overlapping hours.
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with Cloud Providers, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, Iceberg/Delta/Hudi, Airflow, and Python; a strong grasp of distributed systems trade-offs; and experience architecting data ingestion, quality, and cost-optimization solutions at scale.
* Communication & Collaboration: Direct, empathetic, and outcome-focused. Able to align cross-functional stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and influence architectural direction without direct authority.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with CDC patterns and tooling (Debezium or similar).
* Familiarity with dbt or modern transformation frameworks.
* Prior experience building or standing up a new team or engineering hub in a new region.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) or building AI-powered agents for operational use cases.

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Mainframe Technical Tower Support Cost
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Senior IBM Z Disaster Recovery Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining disaster recovery and business continuity solutions for IBM Z (Mainframe) environments. You will ensure the resilience, availability, and recoverability of critical business systems while supporting enterprise-wide recovery objectives and compliance requirements.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Provide technical leadership and hands-on support for IBM Z disaster recovery exercises, failover testing, and recovery events.
* Execute and validate recovery procedures to ensure critical systems, applications, and services meet defined RTO and RPO targets.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, storage, database, middleware, network, and security teams to coordinate successful recovery operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues identified during DR testing, recovery execution, and resilience assessments.
* Maintain and enhance disaster recovery documentation, runbooks, recovery procedures, and operational standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing recovery outcomes, mitigating risks, and strengthening enterprise resiliency and business continuity capabilities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 7+ years of experience in IBM Z (Mainframe) platform administration, operations, infrastructure support, and advanced technical troubleshooting within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience supporting and executing Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity activities in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of IBM Z infrastructure components, including z/OS, storage, networking, database, middleware, and security technologies.
* Experience performing recovery validation, recovery testing, and analysis of DR exercise outcomes.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, production support, incident management, and service restoration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and coordinate recovery activities across multiple technology domains.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with IBM GDPS, Parallel Sysplex, replication technologies, and DR orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of enterprise resiliency, high-availability, and business continuity frameworks.
* Familiarity with Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) management.
* Experience participating in large-scale recovery exercises, failover testing, and audit/compliance activities.
Relevant IBM Mainframe, Infrastructure, Disaster Recovery, or Business Continuity certifications.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Systems Integration Senior Specialist
description:
**MQ IIB Job Description:**  
Middleware - Enterprise Messaging and Integration Administrator
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking -- years of experienced Enterprise Messaging Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise-grade messaging, integration, and workload automation platforms. This role ensures secure, reliable, high-performance communication between distributed applications using IBM, Apache, and open-source messaging technologies. The engineer also manages complex scheduling environments and contributes to automation, observability, and continuous improvement of mission critical integration systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ)
  
  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms.
* Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies.
* Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies.
* Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning.
* Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively.
* Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.

2. Integration Engineering (IBM IIB / ACE)
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy message flows using ESQL, Java, mapping nodes, REST/SOAP connectors, MQ/Kafka nodes.
* Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides.
* Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management.
* Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint.
* Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.

3. IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT)
  
  

* Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies.
* Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies.
* Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.

4. Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS)
  
  

* Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents.
* Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring.
* Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows.
* Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.

5. Security, Governance Compliance
  
  

* Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies:

TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL.
  
  

* Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks.
* Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.

6. Automation, DevOps Observability
  
  

* Create automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring.
* Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning.
* Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.

7. Documentation Collaboration
  
  

* Create runbooks, SOPs, operational guidelines, and architectural diagrams.
* Work closely with application teams, architects, network, cloud, and security teams.
* Participate in on call rotation and production support responsibilities.

Required Skills Experience
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of:

o IBM MQ (Distributed / MQ Clustering / Security)
  
  
o IBM IIB/ACE development administration
  
  
o IBM TWS/IWS job scheduling
  
  
o MQTT / MQXR messaging
  
  
o Apache Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, ACLs, Schema Registry)
  
  
o Apache ActiveMQ (Classic/Artemis)
  
  
o RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)
  
  

* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Strong debugging skills across messaging, network, TLS, and application layers.
* Good understanding of networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancers, proxies).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with Kubernetes (OpenShift/EKS/AKS) for containerized messaging platforms.
* Cloud messaging equivalents (Azure Event Hub, AWS MQ/Kinesis/SNS/SQS, GCP Pub/Sub).
* Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures.

title: Senior Principal - EUC / MDM Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Be the definitive technical authority for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries experience and interact with their devices. This role owns the architecture, reference designs, technical standards and engineering direction for the entire end user computing estate — laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, meeting rooms, and specialised or regulated endpoints.

Where the Director owns delivery, budget and people, the Principal Architect owns what good looks like technically and holds the organisation to it. This is a hands-on-capable role: the expectation is to prototype, prove and pressure-test designs personally, not solely to review other people's slides.

The Principal Architect is accountable for ensuring the estate is secure by design, cloud-native, automatable, cost-efficient and — critically — genuinely pleasant to use. They are the person who says no to architecture that will not survive contact with 50,000 users, and who can explain why in terms both engineers and executives accept.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target-state architecture for end user computing: platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery, security control placement and telemetry.
* Produce and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, technical standards and architecture decision records (ADRs) — with trade-offs made explicit rather than buried.
* Define the technical roadmap that underpins the EUC strategy: platform migrations, deprecations, convergence of fragmented tooling, and the sequencing that makes it deliverable.
* Continuously evaluate the market — modern management, AI PCs and on-device inference, cloud PC/DaaS economics, zero-trust endpoint models — and separate genuine capability from vendor narrative.
* Act as the design authority for all endpoint change: chair or sit on the EUC architecture review board, approve significant designs, and hold veto on standards deviation.
* Set and police the exception process — make the right path the easy path, and make deviations visible, time-bound and owned.
* Review and assure supplier and MSP technical designs; ensure partners build to the organisation's architecture rather than their own delivery convenience.
* Set engineering standards for configuration-as-code, packaging, testing, release management and rollback across the endpoint estate.
* Prototype and prove new capability in a lab before it reaches production; build the reference implementation the engineering teams then industrialise.
* Mentor and technically develop senior engineers and platform leads; raise the ceiling of the whole team, not just your own output.
* Partner with Cyber Security to embed zero-trust principles at the endpoint: device trust and attestation, conditional access, least privilege, application control, EDR and DLP placement.
* Architect for regulated and validated environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), data residency and privacy obligations, and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation as a designed-in property rather than a manual scramble.
* Own the technical response to endpoint-relevant threat scenarios and drive architectural remediation of systemic vulnerabilities.
* Architect the digital employee experience (DEX) telemetry model: what is measured, how it is collected, where it lands, and how it drives automated remediation.
* Design for self-healing and self-service by default; treat every recurring ticket category as an architectural defect until proven otherwise.
* Translate architecture into business consequence for senior stakeholders — cost, risk, productivity, time-to-value.
* Represent EUC architecture in enterprise architecture forums, security governance, and vendor executive briefings.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional expertise.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Jamf Certified Expert, TOGAF, CISSP or SABSA).

**Area of Specialisation**

* End user computing architecture at global enterprise scale — platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery and telemetry.
* Modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management (Jamf), including co-management, hybrid-to-cloud-native migration and staged ring-based rollout.
* Endpoint security architecture and zero-trust design — device trust, conditional access, application control, EDR/XDR, DLP and secure baselines.
* Regulated and validated endpoint environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, CSV/CSA, data residency and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation designed in.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in IT infrastructure or end user computing, including 5+ years in a principal, lead or enterprise architect capacity with recognised design authority.
* Architecture ownership for an endpoint estate of 20,000+ devices across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
* Expert-level, hands-on-derived command of modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management — sufficient to build the reference implementation personally, not only to specify it.
* Demonstrable advanced scripting and automation portfolio; evidence of configuration-as-code applied to a production endpoint estate.
* Working fluency in enterprise endpoint security and zero-trust architecture, with a track record of co-designing controls alongside a Cyber Security function.
* Led the architecture of at least one large-scale endpoint platform migration or transformation through to production, including the failures and what was learned from them.
* Able to produce architecture documentation of a standard that withstands external audit and supplier scrutiny.
* Proven credibility with both senior engineers and executive stakeholders, in English, in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [5–15]% of the time.

Desirable:

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — with practical GxP/CSV/CSA and Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure.
* Architecture for specialised endpoints: laboratory instrument workstations, manufacturing and shop-floor devices, clinical and field devices, kiosks, shared and multi-user workstations.
Leading a major platform transformation: SCCM-to-Intune migration, Windows 10* 11 at scale, MSP transition, or M&A integration/divestment of an endpoint estate.
* Sustainability-aware design — device longevity, power management, refurbishment and Scope 3 implications of architectural choices.
* Accessibility and assistive technology designed into the standard build rather than bolted on.
* Network fundamentals relevant to endpoints — SASE/ZTNA, split tunnelling, Wi-Fi 6/7, certificate-based network access.
* Contribution to the wider community — open-source tooling, conference speaking, published technical writing, vendor customer advisory boards.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across Windows and macOS internals, modern endpoint management, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, virtual desktop / cloud PC, and mobile — with the judgement to know where tenant-wide standardisation matters and where a business exception is defensible.
* Advanced PowerShell and at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Go) applied to real automation, not toy scripts.
* Configuration-as-code and GitOps discipline — version-controlled endpoint configuration, CI/CD for policy and package deployment, automated testing and staged ring-based rollout as the default way endpoint change is delivered.
* API-first integration — Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, MDM and security tool APIs; designing integrations that survive vendor change.
* Telemetry and data craft — designing measurement into the estate, with competence in the query languages and platforms the data lands in (KQL, Log Analytics, Power BI or equivalent).
* Architectural discipline — reference designs, ADRs, HLD/LLD, and the ability to write clearly enough that others can build from it and external auditors can accept it.
* Trade-off reasoning — cost, risk, experience, security and operability weighed explicitly; comfortable being the person who quantifies the uncomfortable option.
* Scale intuition — designing for 50,000 devices, unreliable networks, disconnected users, and the long tail of exceptions that always exists.
* Technical leadership without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery and vendors by credibility and evidence.
* Executive communication — making architecture legible and decision-ready for non-technical leadership.
* Constructive challenge — able to disagree with a Director, a vendor or a security architect and keep the relationship intact.

**Skills**

Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Design Thinking, Endpoint Encryption, Endpoint Security, End User Services, Financial Operations, Jamf Pro, Network Protocols, Network Security, Zero Trust

title: Manager IAM Architecture
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

The IAM Security Assurance Architect is responsible for reviewing all new applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology changes to ensure they meet the organisation's baseline IAM security requirements before they go live.

The role acts as the IAM security review authority within technology delivery and change processes, and builds the automation needed to provide continuous assurance that identity and access controls remain effective throughout the application lifecycle. The focus is on two outcomes: rigorous security reviews and automated, always-on assurance.

Key Responsibilities

1. IAM Security Reviews

* Serve as the IAM security review authority for new applications, technology platforms, cloud workloads, and infrastructure changes.
* Review designs and change requests through project lifecycle and design checkpoint governance processes.
* Assess and approve applications against baseline IAM security requirements, including:
  + Authentication standards
  + MFA requirements
  + Privileged access controls
  + Role-based access models
  + Segregation of Duties requirements
  + Identity lifecycle (joiner / mover / leaver) requirements
  + Account provisioning and deprovisioning controls
  + Service account and non-human identity management standards
  + Federation and Single Sign-On requirements
* Review application access models, role structures, entitlement designs, and access matrices.
* Classify application criticality and confirm IAM onboarding requirements are met.
* Identify security risks, control gaps, and remediation actions, and confirm closure before deployment.
* Provide clear, documented review decisions and risk-based approvals to delivery teams.

2. Assurance Automation & Continuous Compliance

* Design and build automation that continuously validates whether applications and platforms meet baseline IAM security requirements.
* Automate evidence collection and control checks to reduce manual review effort and provide always-on assurance.
* Establish automated, continuous monitoring for:
  + Orphaned accounts
  + Stale and dormant identities
  + Excessive or unused privileges
  + Toxic access combinations
  + Service account and non-human identity risks
  + Privileged account misuse
  + Deviations from approved access baselines
* Integrate assurance checks with IAM platforms and security tooling (e.g., SailPoint, Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, cloud CIEM).
* Define Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and IAM assurance health metrics.
* Build and maintain dashboards that surface control effectiveness and non-compliance for remediation.
* Drive an automate-first approach to control validation, minimising point-in-time manual checks.

3. Remediation, Risk & Reporting

* Track and drive closure of IAM security review findings and assurance exceptions.
* Review IAM-related risk assessments, exceptions, and remediation plans.
* Support internal and external audits with review evidence and assurance data.
* Report on review throughput, control coverage, and residual risk to IAM leadership.

4. Stakeholder Engagement

* Partner with application, engineering, cloud, and change teams to embed security-by-design in delivery.
* Advise project teams on how to meet baseline IAM requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Audit functions on assurance outcomes and control gaps.

Key Deliverables

* IAM Security Review Decisions & Risk-Based Approvals
* Baseline IAM Requirement Assessments for New Applications
* Continuous Assurance Automation & Control Validation Framework
* Automated Evidence Collection & Compliance Checks
* IAM Assurance Dashboards & Metrics (KRIs / KPIs)
* Review Findings, Remediation Tracking & Exception Reviews
* Assurance Reporting for IAM Leadership and Audit

Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

* Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) – SailPoint ISC / IdentityIQ
* Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory
* CyberArk Privileged Access Management
* Authentication & Federation Protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML)
* Cloud Identity Security and CIEM (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Service Account and Non-Human Identity Management
* IAM Automation, Scripting and Orchestration (e.g., Power Automate, Python, APIs)
* Security Analytics, Monitoring and Continuous Assurance Tooling
* Baseline IAM Security Requirements and Control Testing

Review & Assurance Capability

* Security design review and change assessment processes
* Secure-by-design and baseline requirement validation
* Automated control testing and evidence collection
* Technology risk assessment and remediation tracking
* Metrics, KRI/KPI definition and assurance reporting
* Audit support and control effectiveness validation

Professional Experience

* Experience performing IAM or security design reviews for applications and platforms.
* Experience assessing applications against baseline IAM / access control requirements.
* Experience building automation for control validation, evidence collection, or continuous assurance.
* Experience integrating assurance checks with IAM and security tooling.
* Experience tracking and driving remediation of identity and access control gaps.
* Experience engaging with delivery, engineering, risk, and audit stakeholders.

Qualifications & Certifications

Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of overall experience in information security or IT, with 5+ years focused on Identity & Access Management.
* 3+ years performing IAM / security design reviews or control assurance for applications and platforms.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building automation for control validation, evidence collection, or continuous assurance.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications is preferred:

* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
* CIAM / Identity certifications (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft Entra / Identity & Access Administrator SC-300)
* CyberArk Defender / Sentry (Privileged Access Management)
* Cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft SC-100 / AZ-500, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer)
* CCSP – Certified Cloud Security Professional
CISA – Certified Information Systems Auditor (for controls assurance and audit alignment)

We encourage the same standards from our recruitment and third-party suppliers taking into account the context of grade, job and location. We also allow for reasonable adjustments to support people with individual physical or mental health requirements.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  
  
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Perform SAP BASIS administration activities across SAP landscapes (ECC, BW, Solution Manager, S/4HANA, Java systems).
* Monitor and maintain SAP systems to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Execute SAP kernel upgrades, support package implementations, and system refreshes/copies.
* Manage SAP transport activities and troubleshoot transport-related issues.
* Perform client administration, user administration, and security-related BASIS tasks.
* Monitor SAP background jobs, system logs, spool management, and interface connectivity.
* Support HANA database administration activities, including backups and recovery.
* Execute OS and database-level troubleshooting in collaboration with infrastructure teams.
* Participate in incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Support cloud-based SAP environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, SAP RISE) as required.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and operational reports.
Provide on-call support and participate in planned maintenance activities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills**

  

* 3-5 years of SAP BASIS administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and SAP HANA.
* Experience with system monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management and change management processes.
* Experience in system copy, client copy, refresh, upgrades, and patching activities.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows server administration.
* Understanding of backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability concepts.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or SAP RISE environments.
Good understanding of ITIL processes and ticketing tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* SAP BASIS or SAP HANA certification(not mandator. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a plus.
* Experience in SAP RISE operations.
Strong communication, customer handling, and documentation skills.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Security Administrator
description:

**SUMMARY** – The principal purpose of the Senior Security Administrator position is to support and maintain the organization’s security environment by protecting information, systems, and resources from security risks. The role is responsible for implementing security procedures, managing user access, monitoring security activities, and supporting compliance with organizational security policies and standards.

The **Senior Security Administrator** will support the administration, monitoring, and continual improvement of our cybersecurity applications and platforms. The individual will play a key role in ensuring the ongoing functionality of existing security tools. The ideal candidate will have a foundational knowledge of cybersecurity principles and a strong willingness to learn and grow into an engineering-focused career path.

  

* Administer and maintain cybersecurity platforms (e.g., SIEMs, EDR solutions, vulnerability scanners, email security gateways, public security scoring sites).
* Monitor cybersecurity tools and platforms for disruptions, alerts, misconfigurations, and performance issues.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of platforms and escalate significant issues and incidents to senior security staff in a timely manner.

title: clinic counsellor
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, confident and target-driven **Sales Counsellor** to join our skin and aesthetic clinic.

This is a revenue-focused role. The counsellor will be responsible for converting enquiries and leads into consultations and treatments, counselling clients on suitable treatment plans, following up consistently, and ensuring that the clinic meets its daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should be an excellent communicator, comfortable discussing premium aesthetic treatments, persistent with follow-ups, highly organised and able to take ownership of numbers rather than wait for clients to walk in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue**

* Take ownership of the clinic's **daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets**.
* Follow up aggressively and consistently on new leads, enquiries, past consultations and existing clients.
* Convert incoming leads from calls, WhatsApp, digital campaigns, social media and other sources into clinic appointments.
* Counsel clients on relevant skin, hair, laser and aesthetic treatments based on their concerns and the doctor's recommendations.
* Explain treatment plans, packages, pricing, offers and payment options clearly and confidently.
* Identify opportunities for **cross-selling, upselling and treatment upgrades** without compromising the client's experience or clinical appropriateness.
* Follow up with clients who have consulted but not yet purchased or started treatment.
* Reactivate dormant clients and encourage repeat treatments, maintenance plans and package renewals.
* Track upcoming package expiries, incomplete treatment plans and potential repeat business.

**Lead Management & Follow-up**

* Respond promptly to all incoming leads and enquiries.
* Maintain a disciplined follow-up system so that no potential client is lost because of delayed or missed communication.
* Understand the client's concern, establish intent and guide them towards booking a consultation or treatment.
* Maintain detailed notes on every lead, including treatment interest, objections, follow-up dates and conversion status.
* Handle common objections around pricing, treatment concerns, downtime and decision-making confidently and professionally.

**Client Counselling**

* Build rapport quickly and make clients feel comfortable discussing aesthetic concerns.
* Explain treatments in simple, easy-to-understand language.
* Work closely with doctors, nurses and therapists to recommend the right treatment journey for each client.
* Ensure that counselling is persuasive and commercially effective while remaining ethical and aligned with medical recommendations.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to improve retention, referrals and repeat business.

**Reporting & Organisation**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, consultations, conversions and revenue.
* Prepare and update **daily, weekly and monthly sales reports**.
* Review the sales pipeline daily and prioritise high-potential leads.
* Maintain client information and follow-up schedules accurately in the clinic CRM/software or designated trackers.
* Provide regular updates to the Management on performance against targets.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be measured on:

* Monthly clinic revenue achievement
* Individual revenue contribution
* Lead-to-appointment conversion
* Consultation-to-sale conversion
* Follow-up effectiveness
* Repeat and renewal business
* Cross-sell and upsell revenue
* Reactivation of existing/dormant clients
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Client experience and feedback

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly sales-driven and target-oriented**
* Extremely proactive and persistent with follow-ups
* Confident speaking to clients over phone, WhatsApp and in person
* An excellent communicator with strong persuasion and negotiation skills
* Comfortable asking for the sale and closing conversations
* Well organised and disciplined about maintaining follow-up records
* Comfortable working with daily, weekly and monthly targets
* Able to analyse their own pipeline and identify what needs to be done to achieve the target
* Presentable, professional and client-focused
* Able to work independently and take ownership rather than wait for instructions
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced clinic environment

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum **2–3 years of experience in sales, counselling or client conversion**.
* Previous experience in an **aesthetic clinic, dermatology clinic, cosmetic surgery centre, wellness clinic, premium salon or healthcare sales environment** is strongly preferred.
* Experience selling premium treatments, packages or high-value services will be an advantage.
* Strong spoken English is essential. Knowledge of Hindi and/or Kannada is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp and CRM or clinic management software is required.
