title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  

* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: Principal Engineer - Veeva Vault
description:

The Senior Technical SME (Subject Matter Expert) Veeva Quality Vault provides technical leadership within the Enterprise Veeva Quality Suite – technical Team, responsible for contributing to the technical solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Veeva Quality Suite across Content Management, Quality, Audit & Risk business processes.  
The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting and ensures technical outputs aligned with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards. The role acts as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues. The job holder reviews technical specifications, configurations and test evidence and leads root-cause analysis were operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist. The role also develops engineering capability by coaching engineers and super users and converting lessons learned into reusable designs, standards, training and knowledge.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide product expertise in the Veeva Quality Suite as a certified Vault platform administrator and Veeva configuration specialist, while providing technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilization and coordinating internal and supplier engineering resources.
* Implement technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy.
* Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence.
* Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected.
* Design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments and write or review related specifications and test scripts.
* Analyze logs, metrics, monitoring and system behavior to identify defects, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites, while coaching site engineers and super users and contributing to training, runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence.
* Assess technical risks and ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability.
* Maintain technical standards and reusable engineering assets for the assigned product family or platform, while supporting formal technical assurance, audits and inspections and ensuring corrective actions are based on evidence.
* Drive engineering lessons learned and cross-team continuous improvement.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences or another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in technical, cloud, integration, automation, data, validation, cyber security or engineering certifications.
* Minimum of seven years of hands-on technical engineering experience in large-scale enterprise or operational technology environments.
* Experience in leading technical design and implementation for a product family, platform, programme or multiple sites.
* Experience in reviewing and approving specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and technical validation evidence.
* Experience in leading troubleshooting and root-cause investigations across systems, interfaces, workflows, data and infrastructure.
* Experience in coordinating internal engineers, site teams, vendors and specialist partners through design, deployment and stabilization activities.
* Experience in assessing technical risk and ensuring security, data integrity, resilience, compliance and supportability requirements are met.
* Experience in coaching engineers and converting lessons learned into reusable standards, patterns and knowledge assets.
* Experience in supporting audits, inspections and formal technical assurance activities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Demonstrated analytical and structured problem-solving skills, applied to resolving complex technical issues and improving system performance.
* Translate architecture and product direction into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Produces technical documentation and maintains specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records in line with governance requirements.
* Experience in interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support practices.
* Experience in security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change control requirements.
* Collaborates across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams.
* Contributes to continuous improvement activities with focus on standardization, reuse, automation and knowledge sharing.
* Provides technical leadership, including reviewing and constructively challenging designs against requirements and standards.

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's network segmentation and identity-based access platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. title: Associate Director - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

Every person, workload and AI agent at GSK needs an identity it can prove, credentials that cannot be stolen and access that is just enough, just in time. As our applications move to the cloud and AI agents begin working alongside our people, authentication is becoming the foundation of trust for everything we do. The Associate Director, leads the engineering and delivery of that foundation, starting with single sign-on (SSO) and extending the same discipline to Azure and Google Cloud (GCP), non-human identities (NHI) and AI agents.

**Our vision:**

  

One trusted way to authenticate, whoever or whatever is asking for access: passwordless for people, secretless for workloads and tightly scoped for AI agents. Security should be invisible when everything is right and decisive when it is not. We will get there by using AI securely in our own work, setting the example for the rest of GSK.

**About the team:**

  

Authentication and Cloud Security is part of Identity & Access Management. We build and run SSO for GSK’s workforce and applications, and bring the same discipline to securing the accounts, credentials and authentication of cloud, non-human and AI agent identities. Together with PKI & Cryptographic Services, we protect the identities, secrets and keys that GSK’s cloud and AI future depends on.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will turn that vision into reality. Your responsibilities will include:

* **Build one team:** Lead and develop a global team of engineers across SSO, cloud, NHI and AI agent identity, working as one team with shared patterns rather than separate product silos.
* **Deliver the roadmap:** Own the engineering roadmap, delivery plans and service measures, turning the agreed architecture and standards into reliable services.
* **Make sign-in passwordless and trusted:** Run GSK’s SSO services (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), moving the workforce to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, with conditional access, strong identity verification for registration and account recovery, and the retirement of legacy authentication.
* **Secure the cloud:** Protect cloud accounts and access in Azure and GCP with strong authentication, workload identity federation, least privilege and just-in-time access, with no standing admin rights.
* **Bring workloads and AI agents into the fold:** Give non-human identities and AI agents unique, accountable identities kept separate from human ones, with protected credentials, scoped and revocable access and full audit logging, and promote integration with GSK’s identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* **Move from secrets to secretless:** Drive adoption of secrets vaulting and management, remove hard-coded credentials, favour short-lived and secretless authentication, and build secret scanning into engineering pipelines.
* **Partner with PKI:** Work with the PKI & Cryptographic Services lead to secure cloud, AI and secrets, with aligned roadmaps, clear ownership and a joined-up approach for stakeholders and auditors.
* **Use AI ourselves:** Apply AI to identity engineering and operations, such as risky sign-in analysis, anomaly detection, faster onboarding and incident triage, with human oversight and clear audit trails.
* **Set the example:** Show GSK what secure cloud and AI looks like through secure-by-default implementations, reusable patterns, automation and implementation guidelines.
* **Keep trust earned:** Ensure these services meet audit and compliance requirements, including GxP, SOX, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and lead major incidents and continual improvement with partner teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 18 years’ experience in identity or security, including leading engineering teams that deliver and run enterprise identity or security services in a large organisation.
* Strong knowledge of SSO and modern authentication (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), conditional access, multi-factor authentication and passwordless authentication.
* Hands-on experience securing identity and access in Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure role-based access control and workload identities.
* Experience securing non-human identities and secrets, including vaulting, credential rotation and removing embedded secrets, and integrating them with identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and large language model security risks, such as agent permissions, data exposure and prompt injection.
* Strong leadership, delivery and communication skills, including managing roadmaps, suppliers and audits, and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering SSO at scale with Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity, including passwordless authentication and identity verification.
* Experience securing identity and access in Google Cloud (GCP), and with tools for securing non-human identity credentials and cloud privileged access.
* Experience with secrets vaulting and management platforms such as Akeyless, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault or Google Secret Manager.
* Experience securing AI agents or platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI or Copilot, and familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Working understanding of PKI and certificate-based authentication, and experience with Terraform and identity automation.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure Security Engineer or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, passkeys and FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Azure, Google Cloud, Akeyless, CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Graph, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Engineering Leadership, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secure Authentication, Security Controls, Server Security, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Essential Qualities**

* Be approachable and responsive to colleagues and users and have an open-minded and constructive approach to problem solving.

* Development of technical knowledge and skill
* Contribution to target achievement and team goals

Accidental & Life cover 3 times of concerned CTC

As a **Technical People Manager for the Slack Practice** within Salesforce Professional Services (GDC), you will build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Slack technical consultants, developers, and architects. In this role, you will bridge the gap between people leadership, technical architecture, and enterprise delivery excellence.
  
You will partner closely with global practice leaders, onshore engagement managers, and enterprise customers to deliver complex Slack transformations—ranging from large-scale Enterprise Grid migrations and custom app development to next-generation Agentforce and Salesforce integrations.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.

---------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Slack Enterprise Grid & Administration:**
  + Deep understanding of Slack Enterprise Grid topology, multi-workspace scoping, and enterprise governance.
  + Experience with identity lifecycle management: SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and SCIM directory sync.
  + Strong foundation in enterprise security, compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), eDiscovery, Enterprise Key Management (EKM), and the Slack Audit Logs API.

  + Familiarity with the Slack CLI, modular app architecture, manifest files (manifest.json), and Workflow Builder custom functions.

  + Architectural knowledge of migrating from legacy communication platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, freemium/standalone Slack workspaces) to Slack Enterprise Grid.
  + Familiarity with user/channel mapping schemas, export/import APIs, data parity verification, and cutover runbook execution.
* **DevOps & Engineering Standards:**
  + Solid understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing frameworks, and secure API integration standards.
  + Experience hosting Slack apps on cloud infrastructure (Heroku, AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**
-----------------------------------------

  
  

* **Total Experience:** 10-15+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise cloud solutions.
* **Management Experience:** 5+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams (software engineers, technical consultants, or architects) in a global delivery / consulting model.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):**
--------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Salesforce Platform Knowledge:**
  + Familiarity with core Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform Events, Apex, Flow).
  + Hands-on experience or architectural knowledge of integrating Salesforce with Slack (Salesforce for Slack apps, CRM record sync, Agentforce integration).
* **Certifications:**
  + **Certified Slack Administrator** or **Certified Slack Developer** (highly preferred).

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Facility Executive Technical
description:

Facility Engineer with below requirement.
  
  
A. Power Quality, Distribution & ReliabilityOperate and maintain LT systems, transformers, LT panels, PDU/RPP, isolation transformers, and static transfer switches (STS).
  
Ensure N+1 / 2N redundancy for critical loads (process tools, scrubbers, abatement, BMS, safety systems).
  
Monitor harmonics (THD), transients, flicker, and EMI/RFI; implement filters/SPDs and isolation strategies for sensitive tools (litho, metrology).
  
Perform load studies, phase balancing, and feeder capacity checks prior to tool hookups and expansions.
  
B. UPS, Emergency Power & ControlsOperate and maintain UPS (modular/N+1), battery strings, DG sets, AMF/ATS panels; test black start and autotransfer sequences.
  
Periodic battery health tests (IR, discharge tests), UPS efficiency tuning, and firmware/config backup.
  
Maintain Emergency Power Off (EPO) circuits, interlocks with gas monitoring systems, and fire alarm interfaces.
  
C. Grounding, Bonding & ESDMaintain clean/technical grounds, separate from building ground; verify low-impedance paths and equipotential bonding for tools.
  
Implement and audit ESD controls (SEMI S20.20 practices), wrist straps, surfaces, flooring resistance, and static-safe layouts in cleanroom and chase areas.
  
D. Maintenance, Monitoring & ResponseEstablish PM/CBM for panels, breakers, relays, STS, UPS, and IR thermography for hot spots.
  
Trend MTBF/MTTR, create SPC charts for voltage, frequency, THD, and temperature rise.
  
Lead RCA on trips/nuisance faults; implement corrective and preventive actions.
  
E. Safety & Compliance (Electrical)Enforce LOTO, arc-flash boundaries, insulated tools, and PPE.
  
Maintain single-line diagrams, relay settings, test reports (IR, ER), and statutory compliance under CEA Regulations, Indian Electrical Safety Rules, and local inspectorate requirements.
  
Integrate BMS/EPMS alarms, define SOPs for emergency shutdowns and controlled restarts.
  
2) Facility Engineer – Mechanical / Process Utilities (Semiconductor Labs)Primary Objective:
  
Ensure stable, spec-compliant utilities for process tools and cleanroom performance with high uptime and contamination control.
  
A. Cleanroom & HVAC (Critical Environment)Operate and optimize MAUs/AHUs/FFUs, HEPA/ULPA filtration, pressurization cascades, temperature & RH controls.
  
Maintain ISO 14644 cleanroom classes; track particle counts, airflow, and room recovery times.
  
Handle filter life-cycle management, leak tests (DOP/PAO), duct hygiene, and IAQ.
  
Seasonal tuning of coils, economizer modes, and dew point management to prevent condensation in bays/chasers.
  
B. Chilled Water / PCW / Operate chillers (centrifugal/screw), CTs, primary/secondary pumping, and PCW loops for tools.
  
Maintain temperature stability, ΔT, flow, and vibration on critical pumps; maintain N+1 for critical circuits.
  
**Water treatment:** scaling/corrosion inhibitors, biocide control, blowdown optimization.
  
**Trending:** SPC on supply temp, differential pressure, specific energy consumption.
  
C. Ultra-Pure Water (UPW/DI) & WastewaterManage rinse loops, sanitization schedules, and return/reclaim strategies (if applicable).
  
D. Compressed Air (CDA), Vacuum & Inert GasesOperate oil-free compressors, dryers, and filtration to meet dew point and oil/particulate specs; maintain VMB/VMP pressures.
  
Maintain central vacuum and dry pump systems for tools; plan overhauls, flushing, and pump swap programs with OEMs
  
Manage bulk/packaged nitrogen (N₂), vacuum-jacketed lines (if LN₂), and purges for tools and abatement.
  
E. Fire, Life Safety & Exhaust/VentilationMaintain process exhaust, toxic exhaust, and general exhaust with redundancy and failure interlocks.
  
Coordinate with fire detection/suppression (VESDA, clean agent where applicable), and ensure SEMI S2/S6/S8/S18 oriented risk controls.
  
  
F. Maintenance, Monitoring & Analytics PPMCreate PM schedules for pumps, compressors, chillers, FFUs, filters, cabinets, scrubbers, UPW, and neutralization systems.
  
Use BMS to alarm, trend, and report; deploy predictive maintenance (vibration, oil analysis, dew point trends).
  
Maintain spares strategy for high-risk items (VFDs, AHU motors, pump seals, pH probes, sensors, HEPA/ULPA, MERV prefilters).
  
H. Safety & Compliance (Mechanical/Utilities)Enforce PTW/LOTO, confined space, hot work, and chemical handling SOPs.
  
Comply with Factory Act, Boiler Regulations (if applicable), Lift Act, local PCB norms for discharge, PESO/SMPV Rules for gas storage, and explosion-proof ratings where needed.
  
Maintain MSDS/SDS, calibration certificates, and interlock validation records.
  
3) Common Responsibilities (Both Electrical & Mechanical)Projects & Tool HookupsReview PFD/P&ID, MEP/shop drawings, and hook-up packages; validate utility points, capacity, and interlocks.
  
Coordinate FAT/SAT, commissioning, and as-built updates; manage change control and redlining.
  
Plan shutdowns with clear MOPs (Method of Procedure) and rollback plans—particularly when tying into live loops.
  
Operations, Documentation & ReportingMaintain O&M logs, trend charts, equipment history, and SOP/EOP libraries.
  
**Generate MIS:** uptime, incidents, energy use, water use, chemical use, and environmental KPIs (e.g., CUE/WUE).
  
Track OEE, MTBF/MTTR, and SPC metrics for critical utilities and cleanroom performance.
  
Vendor/OEM & AMC ManagementManage AMCs for chillers, compressors, scrubbers, UPS, gas detection, and UPW.
  
Validate service reports, calibration certificates, and PM checklists; enforce spares and response SLAs.
  
Conduct RCA with OEMs for chronic faults and implement design/controls improvements.
  
EHS, Training & CultureRun toolbox talks, competency training (LOTO, toxic gas, electrical safety, ESD, cleanroom behavior).
  
Lead HIRA/JSA, safety walks, and near-miss programs; maintain permit-to-work rigor.
  
Interface with QA/EHS/Process teams to align operational windows with experiment schedules and risk profiles.
  
4) Day/Week/Month Checklist SnapshotDaily
  
**Power quality & alarms (EPMS/BMS):** voltages, THD, breaker statuses, UPS load, battery float.
  
**Cleanroom:** pressures, temp/RH, particle counts (critical bays), FFU/AHU alarms.
  
**Utilities:** CDA dew point & oil carryover, PCW temps/flows, vacuum levels, UPW resistivity/TOC, scrubber DP/pH/ORP.
  
**Gas monitoring:** sensor health, bump tests where applicable; verify EPO/gas shutdown panels healthy.
  
Weekly
  
**Visual checks:** hot spots via IR (rotational basis), pump vibrations, belt/tension, filter DP trends.
  
Test generator no-load/loaded (per schedule), UPS self-tests, review alarm logs & interlock events.
  
Sample & trend UPW bacteria, cooling tower chemistry; verify tool hook-up backflow preventers.
  
Monthly
  
**Full PMs as per OEM:** compressor dryers, scrubber spray nozzles, HVAC coils & filters, UPS battery IR.
  
**Calibration rotation:** gas sensors, pressure/flow/temp transmitters, pH/ORP meters.
  
Emergency drill (gas leak/EPO) and RCA review of any incidents; update SOPs/MOPs/EOPs.
  
**5) Useful Standards/Frameworks to Align WithSEMI:** S2 (EH&S for equipment), S6 (exhaust ventilation), S8 (ergonomics), S18 (risk assessment), S20/S20.20 (ESD).
  
ISO 14644 (cleanrooms), ASHRAE (HVAC), NFPA (fire protection, electrical safety), IEC/IEEE (electrical), FM Global guidance.
  
**India statutory:** CEA Regulations, Factory Act, PESO/SMPV Rules, local PCB and Electrical Inspectorate requirements.
  
6) Optional Add‑Ons I Can Prepare for YouJD template for Facility Engineer (Semiconductor Utilities) – ready to publish.
  
**SOP/MOP/EOP pack for:** tool hook-up, toxic gas alarm response, EPO/power restoration, abatement startup, and scrubber failure.
  
PM matrix (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Annual) with OEM references.
  
Commissioning & handover checklist (FAT/SAT, interlock validation, redlines).
  
  
Educational Qualifications
  

* Diploma in Electrical Engineering
* B.Tech Or BE in Electrical Engineering

Job summary
  
JLL is seeking a Facilities Project Lead to support client by serving as the single point of accountability for vendor contract performance and the planning, procurement, and delivery of small facilities projects. This role ensures vendors deliver the full contracted scope at the agreed quality and cost, and that all projects follow one consistent process from request through closeout. In this role, you will help deliver the simplicity, speed, and consistency that define JLL’s integrated approach to real estate and facilities management. You will work across vendor management, project delivery, budgeting, sourcing, and team leadership while supporting JLL’s purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world and our values of Teamwork, Ethics, and Excellence.
  
  
Key responsibilitiesVendor contract management
  
Own the master register of vendor and subcontractor agreements, including scope, term, pricing, and the responsible account team member.
  
Own performance management of fixed-cost contracts and making the final determination on whether work performed meets the contracted scope, frequency, and quality standard, in consultation with technical leads and Sourcing Manager.
  
Participate in vendor performance reviews with Sourcing Manager and drive scope gaps, quality issues, and corrective actions to resolution.
  
Input into vendor contract renewals, rebids, and scope revisions, including benchmarking and recommendations on whether to renew, renegotiate, or replace.
  
Serve as the escalation point for commercial disputes, change orders, and extra-work requests.
  
Small project management
  
Maintain oversight of a single project log covering status, budget, schedule, and owner, and triage incoming project requests.
  
Develop scopes of work, issue bid packages, lead bid leveling, and recommend awards with clear cost and risk rationale.
  
Manage projects from award through closeout, including schedule, cost, change control, quality inspection, punch lists, and documentation.
  
Coordinate with clinical and operational stakeholders on access, shutdowns, and scheduling in a 24/7 Office environment, including infection control, life safety, and interim measures.
  
Ensure vendor compliance with site safety, permitting, and regulatory requirements.
  
Define and enforce a standard project process used by all project owners on the account.
  
Budgeting and financial management
  
Own the project and vendor contract budget, including forecasting, commitments, cost tracking, and monthly variance reporting.
  
Reconcile invoices against work performed and approved scope before payment approval.
  
Partners with finance and capital project management lead so contract and project spend aligns with operating and capital budgets and client reporting.
  
Flag cost risks and recommend corrective action early.
  
Sourcing and procurement partnership
  
Work with JLL sourcing on vendor selection, contract terms, pricing, and renewals.
  
Follow defined approval thresholds and delegation of authority for awards, change orders, and extra work.
  
Support vendor onboarding and compliance requirements.
  
Team leadership
  
Supervise, coach, and develop direct reports, setting priorities, delegating administrative work, and reviewing output for quality.
  
Build direct reports’ technical knowledge through scope-verification checklists, site walks, and progressively larger project ownership.
  
Conduct regular one-on-ones and support performance and development planning.
  
Cross-functional partnership
  
Partner with technical leads and the Account Director on vendor strategy, risk, and client communication.
  
Identify patterns such as repeat failures, vendor underperformance, and recurring project types, and recommend proactive solutions.
  
Report contract status, cost variances, and risks to the Account Director monthly in a form suitable for client leadership.
  
Recommend vendor modifications based on performance management outcomes.
  
Required qualificationsBachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, facilities management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  
8+ years in facilities management, construction, or project management, ideally in technology sector or critical environment.
  
2+ years of supervisory or team development experience.
  
Demonstrated experience writing scopes, managing bids, and administering fixed-price and time-and-materials contracts.
  
Experience managing project or contract budgets and reconciling vendor invoices.
  
Working knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life safety, sufficient to evaluate scope and quality.
  
Strong negotiation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
  
Proficiency with CMMS or work order systems and Excel.

Experience in a 24/7 Office or other highly regulated operational environment.
  
Experience working within an integrated facilities management model that combines property, workplace, and project management services.

Coordinator developing against documented milestones.
  
Client satisfaction with responsiveness and project communication

title: Head of Regulatory Information Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Head of Regulatory Information Management is accountable for the strategy, governance, operating model and performance of the company's RIM capability, including Regulatory Data Governance. The role sets direction for RIM systems, regulatory data standards, stewardship, quality metrics and continuous improvement across Regulatory Affairs, ensuring trusted regulatory data and effective tools support compliant, scalable business processes. Operational execution, hands-on data maintenance, system administration, document processing, routine system updates and training delivery are performed by designated process owners, business administrators and data stewards under their leadership.  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and lead the RIM strategy, roadmap and target operating model, aligned to Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Quality and enterprise data and digital priorities.
* Lead and develop the RIM team, including recruitment, onboarding, capability building, succession planning and performance management, while fostering an inclusive and accountable team culture.
* Establish and chair RIM and Regulatory Data Governance forums to align priorities, make cross-functional decisions, resolve escalations and maintain clear ownership of systems, processes and data.
* Own the Regulatory Data Governance framework, including data ownership and stewardship, data standards, data quality thresholds, KPIs, issue escalation and lifecycle controls for regulatory master data.
* Set strategic business ownership and governance for the RIM ecosystem, including Veeva RIM, Lorenz docuBridge, AMS, xEVMPD/IDMP processes and related integrations, ensuring investment and release priorities support business needs.
* Define the resource and operating model needed for sustainable delivery and resilience, delegating operational execution to designated business administrators, process owners and data stewards.
* Monitor RIM, regulatory data quality and process performance metrics, using insights to drive risk-based improvements, CAPA effectiveness, leadership decisions and prioritisation.
* Sponsor continuous improvement and transformation initiatives that simplify processes, strengthen data integrity, improve automation and enable global work-sharing, acting as steering leader rather than day-to-day project manager.
* Ensure RIM systems, processes and data governance practices meet QMS, GDP, data integrity and regulatory expectations, and represent RIM/Data Governance in Regulatory Operations leadership, cross-functional governance and selected external/industry interactions.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations or Regulatory Information Management in a regulated life sciences environment, including leadership of global RIM, regulatory systems or regulatory data capabilities.
* Demonstrated people leadership and strategic operating model experience, including budget and resource planning, performance management, capability development and change leadership in a matrix environment.
* Strong understanding of RIM business applications and regulatory data governance, QMS/GxP/GDP, change control, data integrity, regulatory compliance, IDMP/xEVMPD expectations and global registration/submission lifecycle processes.

**Desirable Skills:**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams around shared standards, governance decisions and strategic priorities.
* Experience establishing regulatory data governance, stewardship models, data quality KPIs, issue management and lifecycle controls for regulatory master data.
* Experience shaping digital and data roadmaps, vendor governance and IT-enabled transformation across Veeva Vault/RIM and related regulatory systems.
* Strong analytical, communication and change management capability, with ability to convert metrics, risks and data quality signals into strategy and effective decisions.

title: Netsuite Application Administrator
description:
Revenera helps product executives build better products, accelerate time to value and monetize what matters. Revenera’s leading solutions help software and technology companies drive top line revenue with modern software monetization, understand usage and compliance with software usage analytics, empower the use of open source with software composition analysis and deliver an excellent user experience—for embedded, on premises, cloud, and SaaS products.

Job Description

The NetSuite Business Systems Analyst – Order to Cash (O2C) is a techno-functional role focused on the configuration, development, support, and optimization of Flexera’s NetSuite Order-to-Cash processes. This position serves as a key resource for designing and implementing system solutions across NetSuite, with responsibility for workflows, integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform improvements.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical understanding of NetSuite and knows how to translate business needs into effective system configurations and enhancements. This is not an accounting role. It is a business systems position for someone who can work hands-on in NetSuite to improve automation, scalability, data quality, and operational effectiveness across the O2C cycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

NetSuite O2C & Optimization

Configure, enhance, and support NetSuite functionality across the Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order management, billing, collections, and revenue-related workflows.

Design, build, and maintain NetSuite configurations such as custom fields, forms, records, roles, permissions, workflows, and page layouts aligned to business requirements and internal controls.

Develop and support automation using SuiteFlow and, where applicable, SuiteScript to improve process efficiency and reduce manual work.

Optimize NetSuite modules and capabilities relevant to O2C, including SuiteBilling, Dunning, and Advanced Revenue Management.

Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks, control weaknesses, and data quality issues, and implement scalable improvements.

Support month-end and year-end close activities

Technical Support, Troubleshooting, and System Maintenance

Serve as a technical resource for diagnosing and resolving NetSuite issues related to O2C workflows, configurations, scripts, integrations, and transactional data.

Perform root-cause analysis on system issues and recommend durable corrective actions.

Help maintain overall system health through periodic reviews, testing, cleanup, and performance monitoring.

Perform system administration activities including user roles / permissions, configuration and ongoing platform maintenance

Reporting, Analytics & Integrations

Build and maintain saved searches, dashboards, and custom reports, , and other analytics to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Support and monitor integrations between NetSuite and upstream/downstream business systems, including Salesforce and other connected platforms, using Boomi.

Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor exception handling, and help ensure reliable and accurate data flow across systems.

Document integration specifications, field mappings, technical dependencies and support procedures

Stakeholder Collaboration & Projects

Gather, document, and translate business requirements into system configurations and functional specifications.

Lead UAT, change management, and training for system enhancements and new rollouts.

Act as a key resource during internal and external audits related to O2C controls.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2-5 years of hands-on NetSuite administration or business systems analyst experience.

Demonstrated expertise with NetSuite O2C modules: Advanced Revenue, Billing, Suitebilling, and Dunning

Proficiency in NetSuite SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, suite analytics and reporting.

Experience managing or contributing to system integrations (Celigo, or Boomi preferred).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.

Strong communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Principal - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 10 Years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Engineering, SAP on Azure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Technical Leadership, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most.
