title: Senior HRIS Admin (Workday Benefits & Absences)
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY**  
Q2 is seeking an HRIS Administrator to serve as a functional and technical subject-matter expert for the Benefits and Absence modules within our Workday HCM platform. In this role you will own the day-to-day configuration, administration, and integrity of these modules while partnering closely with Total Rewards, Benefits, and Leave Administration leadership to deliver a seamless employee experience. This role works as a paired backup with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator, so experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking is a plus. You bring proven Workday hands-on expertise and are motivated to drive continuous improvement across the HR technology landscape.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Analysis, Configuration & Technical Excellence**

* Maintain and administer Workday Benefits and Absence modules, including benefit plans, eligibility rules, open enrollment and life event configuration, leave plans, and accrual rules; serve as the primary functional and technical expert for these domains.
* Design and configure multi-step business processes, and lead end-to-end testing cycles for annual open enrollment, plan year changes, and leave policy updates, confirming downstream impacts with stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Workday configuration, calculation, and reporting issues by designing durable fixes and evaluating cross-system impacts using systems thinking.
* Provide backup support for Payroll and Time Tracking module administration, partnering with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator to ensure continuity of coverage.

**Data Integrity & Quality**

* Ensure data accuracy and system integrity across Benefits and Absence, including enrollment audits, deduction reconciliation with Payroll, and carrier and vendor eligibility reconciliation; lead audit data work and implement data quality improvements.
* Write, maintain, and support standard and custom Workday reports and dashboards; ensure system outputs comply with controls and proactively surface insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration workbooks, test results, and help guides across all assigned modules.

**Integrations & Vendor Partnership**

* Support and monitor benefits carrier and vendor integrations (such as medical, dental, vision, 401(k), HSA/FSA, and leave management vendors); resolve file errors, eligibility discrepancies, and enrollment mismatches.
* Partner with benefits brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators on annual plan changes, regulatory updates, and data feed requirements.

**Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Review, assess, and recommend improvements to HRIS workflows, user experience, and system processes; design scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and drive operational efficiency.
* Design and implement multi-step automations that streamline HR workflows; integrate AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy and delivery speed.
* Develop and maintain end-user procedures, guidelines, training materials, and documentation; own training design and delivery for open enrollment, system updates, and platform change readiness.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Partnership**

* Lead requirements definition and solution validation with HR, Benefits, Leave Administration, Payroll, and business stakeholders; serve as a trusted advisor recommending system improvements grounded in user feedback and business needs.
* Lead project workstreams for Workday module implementations and enhancements, aligning system decisions to project goals and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Facilitate strong business partnerships with internal stakeholders, keeping all relevant parties informed, enabling meaningful feedback loops, and representing the HR Technology team with excellence.

**EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of HRIS experience with a strong focus on Workday Benefits and Absence module configuration and administration.
* Strong understanding of HCM design, structure, functions, and processes, including business process workflows, advanced reporting capabilities, and overall system compliance.
* Working knowledge of the following HR business domains: Benefits Administration and Absence/Leave Management, including applicable regulations (such as ACA, ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, and state and local leave laws).
* Organized, detail-oriented, and effective communicator capable of translating complex technical configurations into clear guidance for HR and business stakeholders.
* Self-starter with a strong desire to seek optimal solutions, share discoveries with colleagues, and drive exceptional results.
* Excellent customer service skills and enthusiasm for developing strong partnerships with internal users and leadership.
* Experience with management of SOX/internal compliance audits preferred.
* Experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking modules is a plus, as this role will provide backup support for those functions.
* Experience supporting global Benefits and Absence programs across multiple countries and diverse employee populations preferred.
* Experience working on HRIS or HR Operations teams in a global company, including supporting system configuration and end-user training across geographies preferred.
* Familiarity with HR technology integrations, including benefits carrier feeds, payroll, leave vendors, and third-party systems preferred.

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

**Health & Wellness**

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
* Community Volunteering & Company Philanthropy Programs
* Employee Peer Recognition Programs – “You Earned it”

Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer.

**Our Culture & Commitment:**

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

Department: Food & Beverage Service

Join us in curating an unforgettable dining experience! We need someone dynamic to mastermind our

restaurant's rhythm, seamlessly intertwining guest hospitality with savvy backend logistics. From

crafting warm welcomes to orchestrating reservations and ensuring flawless billing, you'll be the heart

of our operation, keeping our guests beaming. Dive into brand events, loyalty perks, and ace delivery

coordination while keeping our spot gleaming and safe. If you're a problem-solving pro with an eye for

detail and killer organizational skills, come be a part of our vibrant team!

Job Description

Host

* Warmly greet guests upon arrival and ensure their comfort.
* Be a brand ambassador and ability to talk about brand’s current events and promotions
* Customers should receive a detailed overview of the customer loyalty program.
* To exhibit appropriate telephone etiquette.
* Assist with seating arrangements and manage reservations efficiently.
* Maintain a record of reservations and walk-in customers.
* Ensure availability of necessary stationery and amenities.

Dine-In Service

* Make orders promptly and accurately as per Brik Oven standards.
* Communicate effectively about menu items and specials.
* Serve meals as per Brik Oven standards and follow up on guest experience.
* Handle billing and facilitate a smooth departure for guests.
* Perform regular cleaning of tables, counters, and operational areas.
* Ensure proper sanitization of equipment and surfaces.
* Maintain a clean and organized environment conducive to dining.
* Manage petty cash and denominations effectively.
* Ensure all payment systems are operational and tested before service.
* Settlement to be done as per the customer payment mode.
* Manage kitchen order tickets (KOT) efficiently, ensuring accuracy and service standards.

Coffee

* Coffee making as per Brik Oven recipe
* Adequately steam and pull a short of espresso

Grooming

* Adhere to uniform guidelines and maintain a professional appearance as per Brik Oven

standards.

* Ensure personal hygiene and grooming standards are met as per Brik Oven.

Pre and Post-Opening Duties

* Prepare the restaurant for operations before opening.
* Ensure that each individual sections are prepared according to Brik Oven standards to ensure

customer readiness.

* Conduct thorough cleaning and setup tasks after closing.
* Follow pre-established checklists for both front and back-of-house areas.
* Monitor and maintain the physical infrastructure of the restaurant.
* Ensure cleanliness and safety standards are upheld.
* Address any maintenance issues promptly.
* Adherence to the coffee station standards.

Delivery Operations

* Coordinate with delivery aggregators for order processing and tracking.
* Manage kitchen display systems (KDS) for efficient order preparation and delivery.
* Coordinate with online food delivery platforms for seamless order processing.
* Ensure proper integration and visibility on customer apps.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and may be subject

to change as deemed necessary by the Company. Employees are expected to perform any other

related duties as assigned by their supervisor or management, which may include additional tasks

outside the scope of the primary job functions.

Requirements

* To read and write at a beginner level, and to speak at an intermediate level in English.
* 10th Standard completed; additional certification in hospitality is a plus.
* Proven experience in restaurant operations or a similar role.
* Ability to maintain a presentable and well-groomed appearance in accordance with hygiene

title: Lead Engineer - Mechanical Drives
description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. **Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

**Who will you be working with?**

Our best-in-class Mechanical Drives team maintains deep domain expertise related to Locomotive wheels, axles, gears & gearcases, Off-Highway Vehicle transmission assemblies, bearings, seals, and lubricants. Here you’ll interact with various internal and external customers on a global team of engineers that work together to address real word challenges, create customer specific solutions, and develop innovative & reliable products.

**How will you make a difference?**

The Mechanical Drives Engineer will collaborate with a global cross functional team to lead concept development, detail design, and validation for both Locomotive applications as well as Off-Highway Vehicles used in the Mining Industry.

**What do we want to know about you?**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or Structural Engineering
* Minimum 3.0 GPA
* Minimum 5 years of years of experience in mechanical structures engineering
* Experience with mechanical structures, seals on mobile equipment, in rail and/or mining industries
* What **will your typical day look like?**·Mechanical structure (seals, gearcases, wheels, axles, shafts, gears, castings, bearings, housings) design, analysis, and validation leading detailed design reviews with internal and/or external stakeholders Developing and preparing instructions for assembly methods and constraints monitoring and communicating project status, business issues, and significant developments Fatigue evaluation and life predictions – parent material SN curves, weld evaluation, etc. Support the Sourcing function in development and execution of strategic Sourcing initiatives including vendor qualifications and validation testing. Support factory for equipment builds issue resolution & build quality verification. Provide root cause analysis interfacing with leadership and customer. Execute service productivity projects, evaluating performance versus cost trade-offs. You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary. Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met. Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need for accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.

The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 10 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Center Manager

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of hospital billing and admission procedures.
* Basic understanding of insurance and TPA processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office and hospital information systems (HIS).
* Good numerical, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Strong communication and patient-handling abilities.
* Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work in shifts.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of billing and patient documentation.
* Timeliness of admissions and discharge processing.
* Billing error and discrepancy rates.

* Patient satisfaction and query resolution.
* Accuracy of daily cash and billing reconciliation.

title: Senior Slurm Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute infrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You'll own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.
* Administer, configure and tune Slurm clusters - partitions, QOS, accounting, limits, node states and topology - and operate them alongside an existing LSF estate.
* Automate scheduler operations: node onboarding and draining, configuration management, health checks and routine maintenance.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for job throughput, queue wait times and SLA attainment.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will be in the cluster and the scripts yourself, supporting design engineers during local business hours, and day-to-day operations - queue health and job triage - are a core part of the job rather than a side activity.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years in compute infrastructure, with hands-on responsibility for batch scheduling.
* Strong practical Slurm experience: configuration, partitions and QOS, accounting via slurmdbd, node management, and troubleshooting real job failures in production.
* Exposure to a second scheduler, LSF preferred, or a clear appetite to pick one up quickly.
* Solid Linux systems administration - filesystems, NFS, networking, process and resource management.
* Working automation skills in Python and shell, and experience with monitoring and dashboarding tools.
* Comfortable carrying a real operational load - you treat production support and escalations as part of the engineering job. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Principal Engineer - ServiceNow (ITOM)
description:
**Job Title**

Principal Engineer - ServiceNow (ITOM) **About the Role**

As a ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) Principal Engineer, you will act as a key technical expert and collaborative leader helping shape the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of enterprise-scale ITOM capabilities on our ServiceNow platform.

You’ll work closely with architects, platform teams, product managers, and partners across cloud and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, secure, and sustainable solutions that support our digital transformation goals.

**In this Role, You’ll**

* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to define and evolve ServiceNow ITOM strategies.
* Design scalable ITOM solutions across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform).
* Lead and guide teams in platform engineering, configuration, and optimization across Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB (Configuration Management Database), and Event Management.
* Develop and promote standardized frameworks, automation assets, and reusable solutions.
* Support platform governance, architecture reviews, and continuous technical improvements.
* Integrate observability, monitoring, and automation tools to enhance operational reliability.
* Partner with DevOps and agile teams to improve continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices.
* Enable data accuracy and governance through Common Service Data Model (CSDM) adoption.
* Contribute to innovation through proofs of concept and technology evaluation.

**Your Profile**

* Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in IT operations, design, or engineering, including deep ServiceNow platform expertise.
* Proven experience leading or contributing to enterprise ITOM implementations.
* Strong understanding of Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, and Observability practices.
* Familiarity with integrating multiple platforms using REST APIs, Flow Designer, or equivalent methods.
* Proficiency with cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or PowerShell scripting for automation is desirable.
* ServiceNow certifications such as System Administrator (CSA), Application Developer (CAD), or Discovery Implementation Specialist are advantageous.
* Collaborative communication style, problem-solving mindset, and openness to mentoring and continuous learning.

### **What We Can Offer You**

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

  

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Servicenow Platform Architect
description:

The engineer collaborates with different teams to maintain system stability and swiftly resolve incidents, contributing to uninterrupted business processes and enhanced user experience.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. * Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, providing quick and effective solutions.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* A proactive approach to system monitoring and issue resolution.

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' work from office.

* Ensure adherence to all IT standards, policies, and procedures, and enforce compliance within the team

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including automation and process optimization within the service desk
* Prepare and present performance reports, metrics, and insights to leadership

* Strong familiarity with ServiceNow, including troubleshooting and workflow management

* Experience supporting North America customers and time zones
* Working knowledge of MFA, Office 365, Exchange, WEBEX, and TeamViewer

What you will do


Provide Level 1 \& Level 2 support for M365 incidents not resolved by the Service Desk. Perform incident triage, resolution, and escalation to KPMG Global or third‑party resolver groups. Confirm resolution with end users before ticket closure. Analyse incident trends and contribute to knowledge articles. Monitor M365 services (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive). Use ITSM tools for incident tracking and service status reporting. Provide tenant‑level reporting and scripting to support compliance. Configure and manage Teams collaboration, Enterprise Voice, call queues, auto attendants, and Teams Rooms (Option A). Support file sharing and collaboration in OneDrive and SharePoint Online. Troubleshoot Outlook Web Access and mailbox issues.


Identify and escalate incidents related to client/system policies. Support configuration of safe links, safe attachments, conditional access, and DLP policies. Assist in monitoring alerts/events in the M365 security \& compliance dashboard. Configure and manage shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and functional mailboxes. Perform User Access Management (UAM) to validate license/service assignments. Maintain and update M365 support knowledge base. Conduct formal reviews of documentation every six months. Enhance self‑service and automation capabilities. Direct users to “how‑to” content and collect feedback for service improvements.


**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required skills and experience**

* Strong expertise in **Microsoft 365 administration** ( **Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Planner, Forms, Viva, and Co\-pilot Studio) Additional skills required (Mimecast, IronPort, Proofpoint)** with minimum of 3 years of Experience.
* Required experience in Power Platform.
* Proficiency with **ITSM tools** (ServiceNow or equivalent).
* Knowledge of **identity and access management** (Entra ID/Azure AD).
* Experience with **PowerShell scripting** for reporting and automation.
* Familiarity with **Teams Enterprise Voice** provisioning and PSTN integration.
* Understanding of **security and compliance policies** (DLP, conditional access, safe links/attachments).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

**Preferred skills and experience**

* **Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert**
* **Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate**
* **Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate**
* **ITIL Foundation Certification** (for incident/problem management processes)
* **CompTIA Security\+** or equivalent (for compliance/security awareness)

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
